verses.original: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ إِذَا جَآءَكَ ٱلْمُنَٰفِقُونَ قَالُوا۟ نَشْهَدُ إِنَّكَ لَرَسُولُ ٱللَّهِ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ يَعْلَمُ إِنَّكَ لَرَسُولُهُۥ وَٱللَّهُ يَشْهَدُ إِنَّ ٱلْمُنَٰفِقِينَ لَكَٰذِبُونَ
verses.translit: Izaa jaaa'akal munaafiqoona qaaloo nashhadu innaka la rasoolul laah; wallaahu ya'lamu innaka la rasooluhoo wallaahu yashhadu innal munaafiqeena lakaaziboon
verses.translation: When the hypocrites come unto thee (O Muhammad), they say: We bear witness that thou art indeed Allah's messenger. And Allah knoweth that thou art indeed His messenger, and Allah beareth witness that the hypocrites indeed are speaking falsely.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: ٱتَّخَذُوٓا۟ أَيْمَٰنَهُمْ جُنَّةًۭ فَصَدُّوا۟ عَن سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ ۚ إِنَّهُمْ سَآءَ مَا كَانُوا۟ يَعْمَلُونَ
verses.translit: Ittakhazoo aymaanahum junnatan fasaddoo 'an sabeelil laah; innahum saaa'a maa kaanoo ya'maloon
verses.translation: They make their faith a pretext so that they may turn (men) from the way of Allah. Verily evil is that which they are wont to do,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّهُمْ ءَامَنُوا۟ ثُمَّ كَفَرُوا۟ فَطُبِعَ عَلَىٰ قُلُوبِهِمْ فَهُمْ لَا يَفْقَهُونَ
verses.translit: Zaalika bi annahum aamanoo summa kafaroo fatubi'a 'alaa quloobihim fahum laa yafqahoon
verses.translation: That is because they believed, then disbelieved, therefore their hearts are sealed so that they understand not.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: ۞ وَإِذَا رَأَيْتَهُمْ تُعْجِبُكَ أَجْسَامُهُمْ ۖ وَإِن يَقُولُوا۟ تَسْمَعْ لِقَوْلِهِمْ ۖ كَأَنَّهُمْ خُشُبٌۭ مُّسَنَّدَةٌۭ ۖ يَحْسَبُونَ كُلَّ صَيْحَةٍ عَلَيْهِمْ ۚ هُمُ ٱلْعَدُوُّ فَٱحْذَرْهُمْ ۚ قَٰتَلَهُمُ ٱللَّهُ ۖ أَنَّىٰ يُؤْفَكُونَ
verses.translit: Wa izaa ra aytahum tu'jibuka ajsaamuhum wa iny yaqooloo tasma' liqawlihim kaannahum khushubum musannadah; yahsaboona kulla saihatin 'alaihim; humul 'aduwwu fahzarhum; qaatalahumul laahu annaa yu'fakoon
verses.translation: And when thou seest them their figures please thee; and if they speak thou givest ear unto their speech. (They are) as though they were blocks of wood in striped cloaks. They deem every shout to be against them. They are the enemy, so beware of them. Allah confound them! How they are perverted!
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَإِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمْ تَعَالَوْا۟ يَسْتَغْفِرْ لَكُمْ رَسُولُ ٱللَّهِ لَوَّوْا۟ رُءُوسَهُمْ وَرَأَيْتَهُمْ يَصُدُّونَ وَهُم مُّسْتَكْبِرُونَ
verses.translit: Wa izaa qeela lahum ta'aalaw yastaghfir lakum rasoolul laahi lawwaw ru'oo sahum wa ra aytahum yasuddoona wa hum mustakbiroon
verses.translation: And when it is said unto them: Come! The messenger of Allah will ask forgiveness for you! they avert their faces and thou seest them turning away, disdainful.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: سَوَآءٌ عَلَيْهِمْ أَسْتَغْفَرْتَ لَهُمْ أَمْ لَمْ تَسْتَغْفِرْ لَهُمْ لَن يَغْفِرَ ٱللَّهُ لَهُمْ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يَهْدِى ٱلْقَوْمَ ٱلْفَٰسِقِينَ
verses.translit: Sawaaa'un 'alaihim as taghfarta lahum am lam tastaghfir lahum lany yaghfiral laahu lahum; innal laaha laa yahdil qawmal faasiqeen
verses.translation: Whether thou ask forgiveness for them or ask not forgiveness for them is all one for them; Allah will not forgive them. Lo! Allah guideth not the evil-living folk.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: هُمُ ٱلَّذِينَ يَقُولُونَ لَا تُنفِقُوا۟ عَلَىٰ مَنْ عِندَ رَسُولِ ٱللَّهِ حَتَّىٰ يَنفَضُّوا۟ ۗ وَلِلَّهِ خَزَآئِنُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَلَٰكِنَّ ٱلْمُنَٰفِقِينَ لَا يَفْقَهُونَ
verses.translit: Humul lazeena yaqooloona laa tunfiqoo 'alaa man inda Rasoolil laahi hatta yanfaddoo; wa lillaahi khazaaa' inus samaawaati wal ardi wa laakinnal munaafiqeena la yafqahoon
verses.translation: They it is who say: Spend not on behalf of those (who dwell) with Allah's messenger that they may disperse (and go away from you); when Allah's are the treasures of the heavens and the earth; but the hypocrites comprehend not.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: يَقُولُونَ لَئِن رَّجَعْنَآ إِلَى ٱلْمَدِينَةِ لَيُخْرِجَنَّ ٱلْأَعَزُّ مِنْهَا ٱلْأَذَلَّ ۚ وَلِلَّهِ ٱلْعِزَّةُ وَلِرَسُولِهِۦ وَلِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَلَٰكِنَّ ٱلْمُنَٰفِقِينَ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
verses.translit: Yaqooloona la'ir raja'naaa ilal madeenati la yukhrijanal a'azzu minhal azall; wa lillaahil 'izzatu wa li Rasoolihee wa lilmu'mineena wa laakinnal munaafiqeena laa ya'lamoon
verses.translation: They say: Surely, if we return to Al-Madinah the mightier will soon drive out the weaker; when might belongeth to Allah and to His messenger and to the believers; but the hypocrites know not.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ لَا تُلْهِكُمْ أَمْوَٰلُكُمْ وَلَآ أَوْلَٰدُكُمْ عَن ذِكْرِ ٱللَّهِ ۚ وَمَن يَفْعَلْ ذَٰلِكَ فَأُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْخَٰسِرُونَ
verses.translit: Yaaa ayyuhal lazeena aamanoo la tulhikum amwaalukum wa laa awlaadukum 'anzikril laah; wa mai-yaf'al zaalika fa-ulaaa'ika humul khaasiroon
verses.translation: O ye who believe! Let not your wealth nor your children distract you from remembrance of Allah. Those who do so, they are the losers.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَأَنفِقُوا۟ مِن مَّا رَزَقْنَٰكُم مِّن قَبْلِ أَن يَأْتِىَ أَحَدَكُمُ ٱلْمَوْتُ فَيَقُولَ رَبِّ لَوْلَآ أَخَّرْتَنِىٓ إِلَىٰٓ أَجَلٍۢ قَرِيبٍۢ فَأَصَّدَّقَ وَأَكُن مِّنَ ٱلصَّٰلِحِينَ
verses.translit: Wa anifqoo mim maa razaqnaakum min qabli any-yaatiya ahadakumul mawtu fa yaqoola rabbi law laaa akhkhartaneee ilaaa ajalin qareebin fa assaddaqa wa akum minassaaliheen
verses.translation: And spend of that wherewith We have provided you before death cometh unto one of you and he saith: My Lord! If only thou wouldst reprieve me for a little while, then I would give alms and be among the righteous.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَلَن يُؤَخِّرَ ٱللَّهُ نَفْسًا إِذَا جَآءَ أَجَلُهَا ۚ وَٱللَّهُ خَبِيرٌۢ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ
verses.translit: Wa lany yu 'akhkhiral laahu nafsan izaa jaaa'a ajaluhaa; wallaahu khabeerum bimaa ta'maloon
verses.translation: But Allah reprieveth no soul when its term cometh, and Allah is Informed of what ye do.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ يُسَبِّحُ لِلَّهِ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ ۖ لَهُ ٱلْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ ٱلْحَمْدُ ۖ وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍۢ قَدِيرٌ
verses.translit: Yusabbihu lillaahi maa fis samaawaati wa maa fil ardi lahul mulku wa lahul hamd, wa Huwa 'alaa kulli shai 'in Qadeer
verses.translation: All that is in the heavens and all that is in the earth glorifieth Allah; unto Him belongeth Sovereignty and unto Him belongeth praise, and He is Able to do all things.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: هُوَ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَكُمْ فَمِنكُمْ كَافِرٌۭ وَمِنكُم مُّؤْمِنٌۭ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ بَصِيرٌ
verses.translit: Huwal lazee khalaqakum faminkum kaafirunw wa min kum mu'min ; wallaahu bimaa ta'maloona Baseer
verses.translation: He it is Who created you, but one of you is a disbeliever and one of you is a believer, and Allah is Seer of what ye do.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ بِٱلْحَقِّ وَصَوَّرَكُمْ فَأَحْسَنَ صُوَرَكُمْ ۖ وَإِلَيْهِ ٱلْمَصِيرُ
verses.translit: Khalaqas samaawaati wal arda bilhaqqi wa sawwarakum fa ahsana suwarakum wa ilaihil maseer
verses.translation: He created the heavens and the earth with truth, and He shaped you and made good your shapes, and unto Him is the journeying.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: يَعْلَمُ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَيَعْلَمُ مَا تُسِرُّونَ وَمَا تُعْلِنُونَ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ عَلِيمٌۢ بِذَاتِ ٱلصُّدُورِ
verses.translit: Ya'lamu maa fis samaawaati wal ardi wa ya'lamu maa tusirroona wa maa tu'linoon; wallaahu 'Aleemum bizaatis sudoor
verses.translation: He knoweth all that is in the heavens and the earth, and He knoweth what ye conceal and what ye publish. And Allah is Aware of what is in the breasts (of men).
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: أَلَمْ يَأْتِكُمْ نَبَؤُا۟ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ مِن قَبْلُ فَذَاقُوا۟ وَبَالَ أَمْرِهِمْ وَلَهُمْ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌۭ
verses.translit: Alam yaatikum naba'ul lazeena kafaroo min qablu fazaaqoo wabaala amrihim wa lahum 'azaabun aleem
verses.translation: Hath not the story reached you of those who disbelieved of old and so did taste the ill-effects of their conduct, and theirs will be a painful doom.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّهُۥ كَانَت تَّأْتِيهِمْ رُسُلُهُم بِٱلْبَيِّنَٰتِ فَقَالُوٓا۟ أَبَشَرٌۭ يَهْدُونَنَا فَكَفَرُوا۟ وَتَوَلَّوا۟ ۚ وَّٱسْتَغْنَى ٱللَّهُ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ غَنِىٌّ حَمِيدٌۭ
verses.translit: Zaalika bi annahoo kaanat taateehim Rusuluhum bilbaiyinaati faqaaloo a basharuny yahdoonanaa fakafaroo wa tawallaw; wastaghnal laah; wallaahu ghaniyyun hameed
verses.translation: That was because their messengers (from Allah) kept coming unto them with clear proofs (of Allah's Sovereignty), but they said: Shall mere mortals guide us? So they disbelieved and turned away, and Allah was independent (of them). Allah is Absolute, Owner of Praise.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: زَعَمَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوٓا۟ أَن لَّن يُبْعَثُوا۟ ۚ قُلْ بَلَىٰ وَرَبِّى لَتُبْعَثُنَّ ثُمَّ لَتُنَبَّؤُنَّ بِمَا عَمِلْتُمْ ۚ وَذَٰلِكَ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ يَسِيرٌۭ
verses.translit: Za'amal lazeena kafarooo al-lany yub'asoo; qul balaa wa rabbee latub'asunna summa latunabba'unna bimaa 'amiltum; wa zaalika 'alal laahi yaseer
verses.translation: Those who disbelieve assert that they will not be raised again. Say (unto them, O Muhammad): Yea, verily, by my Lord! ye will be raised again and then ye will be informed of what ye did; and that is easy for Allah.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: فَـَٔامِنُوا۟ بِٱللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِۦ وَٱلنُّورِ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَنزَلْنَا ۚ وَٱللَّهُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ خَبِيرٌۭ
verses.translit: Fa-aaminoo billaahi wa rasoolihee wannooril lazeee anzalnaa; wallaahu bima ta'maloona khabeer
verses.translation: So believe in Allah and His messenger and the light which We have revealed. And Allah is Informed of what ye do.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: يَوْمَ يَجْمَعُكُمْ لِيَوْمِ ٱلْجَمْعِ ۖ ذَٰلِكَ يَوْمُ ٱلتَّغَابُنِ ۗ وَمَن يُؤْمِنۢ بِٱللَّهِ وَيَعْمَلْ صَٰلِحًۭا يُكَفِّرْ عَنْهُ سَيِّـَٔاتِهِۦ وَيُدْخِلْهُ جَنَّٰتٍۢ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا ٱلْأَنْهَٰرُ خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَآ أَبَدًۭا ۚ ذَٰلِكَ ٱلْفَوْزُ ٱلْعَظِيمُ
verses.translit: Ywma yajma'ukum li yawmil jam'i zaalika yawmut taghaabun; wa many-yumim billaahi wa ya'mal saalihany yukaffir 'anhu sayyi aatihee wa yudkhilhu jannaatin tajree min tahtihal anhaaru khaalideena feehaaa abadaa; zaalikal fawzul 'azeem
verses.translation: The day when He shall gather you unto the Day of Assembling, that will be a day of mutual disillusion. And whoso believeth in Allah and doeth right, He will remit from him his evil deeds and will bring him unto Gardens underneath which rivers flow, therein to abide for ever. That is the supreme triumph.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ وَكَذَّبُوا۟ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَآ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ أَصْحَٰبُ ٱلنَّارِ خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَا ۖ وَبِئْسَ ٱلْمَصِيرُ
verses.translit: Wallazeena kafaroo wa kazzaboo bi aayaaatinaaa ulaaa'ika ashaabun naari khaalideena feehaa bi'sal maseer
verses.translation: But those who disbelieve and deny Our revelations, such are owners of the Fire; they will abide therein - a hapless journey's end!
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: مَآ أَصَابَ مِن مُّصِيبَةٍ إِلَّا بِإِذْنِ ٱللَّهِ ۗ وَمَن يُؤْمِنۢ بِٱللَّهِ يَهْدِ قَلْبَهُۥ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ بِكُلِّ شَىْءٍ عَلِيمٌۭ
verses.translit: Maaa asaaba mim musee batin illaa bi-iznil laah; wa many yu'mim billaahi yahdi qalbah; wallaahu bikulli shai;in Aleem
verses.translation: No calamity befalleth save by Allah's leave. And whosoever believeth in Allah, He guideth his heart. And Allah is Knower of all things.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَأَطِيعُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُوا۟ ٱلرَّسُولَ ۚ فَإِن تَوَلَّيْتُمْ فَإِنَّمَا عَلَىٰ رَسُولِنَا ٱلْبَلَٰغُ ٱلْمُبِينُ
verses.translit: Wa atee'ul laaha wa atee'ur Rasool; fa in tawallaitum fa innamaa 'alaa Rasoolinal balaaghul mubeen
verses.translation: Obey Allah and obey His messenger; but if ye turn away, then the duty of Our messenger is only to convey (the message) plainly.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: ٱللَّهُ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ ۚ وَعَلَى ٱللَّهِ فَلْيَتَوَكَّلِ ٱلْمُؤْمِنُونَ
verses.translit: Allaahu laaa ilaaha illaa Hoo; wa 'alal laahi falyata wakkalil mu'minoon
verses.translation: Allah! There is no Allah save Him. In Allah, therefore, let believers put their trust.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ إِنَّ مِنْ أَزْوَٰجِكُمْ وَأَوْلَٰدِكُمْ عَدُوًّۭا لَّكُمْ فَٱحْذَرُوهُمْ ۚ وَإِن تَعْفُوا۟ وَتَصْفَحُوا۟ وَتَغْفِرُوا۟ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَفُورٌۭ رَّحِيمٌ
verses.translit: Yaaa ayyuhal lazeena aamanooo inna min azwaaji kum wa awlaadikum 'aduwwal lakum fahzaroohum; wa in ta'foo wa tasfahoo wa taghfiroo fa innal laaha ghafoorur Raheem
verses.translation: O ye who believe! Lo! among your wives and your children there are enemies for you, therefor beware of them. And if ye efface and overlook and forgive, then lo! Allah is Forgiving, Merciful.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: إِنَّمَآ أَمْوَٰلُكُمْ وَأَوْلَٰدُكُمْ فِتْنَةٌۭ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ عِندَهُۥٓ أَجْرٌ عَظِيمٌۭ
verses.translit: Innamaa amwaalukum wa awlaadukum fitnah; wallaahu 'indahooo ajrun 'azeem
verses.translation: Your wealth and your children are only a temptation, whereas Allah! with Him is an immense reward.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: فَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ مَا ٱسْتَطَعْتُمْ وَٱسْمَعُوا۟ وَأَطِيعُوا۟ وَأَنفِقُوا۟ خَيْرًۭا لِّأَنفُسِكُمْ ۗ وَمَن يُوقَ شُحَّ نَفْسِهِۦ فَأُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْمُفْلِحُونَ
verses.translit: Fattaqul laaha mastat'tum wasma'oo wa atee'oo waanfiqoo khairal li anfusikum; wa many-yooqa shuha nafsihee fa-ulaaa'ika humul muflihoon
verses.translation: So keep your duty to Allah as best ye can, and listen, and obey, and spend; that is better for your souls. And whoso is saved from his own greed, such are the successful.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: إِن تُقْرِضُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ قَرْضًا حَسَنًۭا يُضَٰعِفْهُ لَكُمْ وَيَغْفِرْ لَكُمْ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ شَكُورٌ حَلِيمٌ
verses.translit: In tuqridul laaha qardan hasanany yudd'ifhu lakum wa yaghfir lakum; wallaahu Shakoorun Haleem
verses.translation: If ye lend unto Allah a goodly loan, He will double it for you and will forgive you, for Allah is Responsive, Clement,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: Knower of the Invisible and the Visible, the Mighty, the Wise.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّبِىُّ إِذَا طَلَّقْتُمُ ٱلنِّسَآءَ فَطَلِّقُوهُنَّ لِعِدَّتِهِنَّ وَأَحْصُوا۟ ٱلْعِدَّةَ ۖ وَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ رَبَّكُمْ ۖ لَا تُخْرِجُوهُنَّ مِنۢ بُيُوتِهِنَّ وَلَا يَخْرُجْنَ إِلَّآ أَن يَأْتِينَ بِفَٰحِشَةٍۢ مُّبَيِّنَةٍۢ ۚ وَتِلْكَ حُدُودُ ٱللَّهِ ۚ وَمَن يَتَعَدَّ حُدُودَ ٱللَّهِ فَقَدْ ظَلَمَ نَفْسَهُۥ ۚ لَا تَدْرِى لَعَلَّ ٱللَّهَ يُحْدِثُ بَعْدَ ذَٰلِكَ أَمْرًۭا
verses.translit: Yaaa ayyuhan nabiyyu izaa tallaqtummun nisaaa'a fatalliqoohunna li'iddatihinna wa ahsul'iddata; wattaqul laaha rabbakum laa tukhri joohunna mim bu-yootihinna wa laa yakhrujna illaaa any yaateema bifaahishatim mubaiyinah; wa tilka hudoodul laah; wa many yata'adda hudoodal laahi faqad zalama nafsha; laa tadree la'allal laaha yuhdisu ba'dazaalika amraa
verses.translation: O Prophet! When ye (men) put away women, put them away for their (legal) period and reckon the period, and keep your duty to Allah, your Lord. Expel them not from their houses nor let them go forth unless they commit open immorality. Such are the limits (imposed by) Allah; and whoso transgresseth Allah's limits, he verily wrongeth his soul. Thou knowest not: it may be that Allah will afterward bring some new thing to pass.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: فَإِذَا بَلَغْنَ أَجَلَهُنَّ فَأَمْسِكُوهُنَّ بِمَعْرُوفٍ أَوْ فَارِقُوهُنَّ بِمَعْرُوفٍۢ وَأَشْهِدُوا۟ ذَوَىْ عَدْلٍۢ مِّنكُمْ وَأَقِيمُوا۟ ٱلشَّهَٰدَةَ لِلَّهِ ۚ ذَٰلِكُمْ يُوعَظُ بِهِۦ مَن كَانَ يُؤْمِنُ بِٱللَّهِ وَٱلْيَوْمِ ٱلْءَاخِرِ ۚ وَمَن يَتَّقِ ٱللَّهَ يَجْعَل لَّهُۥ مَخْرَجًۭا
verses.translit: Fa izaa balaghna ajalahunna fa amsikoohunna bima'roofin aw faariqoohunna bima'roofinw wa ashhidoo zawai 'adlim minkum wa aqeemush shahaadata lillaah; zaalikum yoo'azu bihee man kaana yu'minu billaahi wal yawmil aakhir; wa many yattaqil laaha yaj'al lahoo makhrajaa
verses.translation: Then, when they have reached their term, take them back in kindness or part from them in kindness, and call to witness two just men among you, and keep your testimony upright for Allah. Whoso believeth in Allah and the Last Day is exhorted to act thus. And whosoever keepeth his duty to Allah, Allah will appoint a way out for him,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَيَرْزُقْهُ مِنْ حَيْثُ لَا يَحْتَسِبُ ۚ وَمَن يَتَوَكَّلْ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ فَهُوَ حَسْبُهُۥٓ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ بَٰلِغُ أَمْرِهِۦ ۚ قَدْ جَعَلَ ٱللَّهُ لِكُلِّ شَىْءٍۢ قَدْرًۭا
verses.translit: Wa yarzuqhu min haisu laa yahtasib; wa many yatawakkal 'alal laahi fahuwa husbuh; innal laaha baalighu amrih; qad ja'alal laahu likulli shai'in qadraa
verses.translation: And will provide for him from (a quarter) whence he hath no expectation. And whosoever putteth his trust in Allah, He will suffice him. Lo! Allah bringeth His command to pass. Allah hath set a measure for all things.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَٱلَّٰٓـِٔى يَئِسْنَ مِنَ ٱلْمَحِيضِ مِن نِّسَآئِكُمْ إِنِ ٱرْتَبْتُمْ فَعِدَّتُهُنَّ ثَلَٰثَةُ أَشْهُرٍۢ وَٱلَّٰٓـِٔى لَمْ يَحِضْنَ ۚ وَأُو۟لَٰتُ ٱلْأَحْمَالِ أَجَلُهُنَّ أَن يَضَعْنَ حَمْلَهُنَّ ۚ وَمَن يَتَّقِ ٱللَّهَ يَجْعَل لَّهُۥ مِنْ أَمْرِهِۦ يُسْرًۭا
verses.translit: Wallaaa'ee ya'isna minal maheedi min nisaaa 'ikum inir tabtum fa'iddatuhunna salaasatu ashhurinw wallaaa'ee lam yahidn; wa ulaatul ahmaali ajaluhunna any yada'na hamlahun; wa many yattaqil laaha yaj'al lahoo min armrihee yusraa
verses.translation: And for such of your women as despair of menstruation, if ye doubt, their period (of waiting) shall be three months, along with those who have it not. And for those with child, their period shall be till they bring forth their burden. And whosoever keepeth his duty to Allah, He maketh his course easy for him.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: ذَٰلِكَ أَمْرُ ٱللَّهِ أَنزَلَهُۥٓ إِلَيْكُمْ ۚ وَمَن يَتَّقِ ٱللَّهَ يُكَفِّرْ عَنْهُ سَيِّـَٔاتِهِۦ وَيُعْظِمْ لَهُۥٓ أَجْرًا
verses.translit: Zaalika amrul laahi anzalahoo ilaikum; wa many yattaqil laaha yukaffir 'anhu saiyi aatihee wa yu'zim lahoo ajraa
verses.translation: That is the commandment of Allah which He revealeth unto you. And whoso keepeth his duty to Allah, He will remit from him his evil deeds and magnify reward for him.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: أَسْكِنُوهُنَّ مِنْ حَيْثُ سَكَنتُم مِّن وُجْدِكُمْ وَلَا تُضَآرُّوهُنَّ لِتُضَيِّقُوا۟ عَلَيْهِنَّ ۚ وَإِن كُنَّ أُو۟لَٰتِ حَمْلٍۢ فَأَنفِقُوا۟ عَلَيْهِنَّ حَتَّىٰ يَضَعْنَ حَمْلَهُنَّ ۚ فَإِنْ أَرْضَعْنَ لَكُمْ فَـَٔاتُوهُنَّ أُجُورَهُنَّ ۖ وَأْتَمِرُوا۟ بَيْنَكُم بِمَعْرُوفٍۢ ۖ وَإِن تَعَاسَرْتُمْ فَسَتُرْضِعُ لَهُۥٓ أُخْرَىٰ
verses.translit: Askinoohunna min haisu sakantum minw wujdikum wa laa tudaaarroohunna litudaiyiqoo 'alaihinn; wa in kunna ulaati hamlin fa anfiqoo 'alihinna hattaa yada'na hamlahunn; fain arda'na lakum fa aatoo hunna ujoorahunna waatamiroo bainakum bima'roofinw wa in ta'aasartum fasaturdi'u lahooo ukhraa
verses.translation: Lodge them where ye dwell, according to your wealth, and harass them not so as to straiten life for them. And if they are with child, then spend for them till they bring forth their burden. Then, if they give suck for you, give them their due payment and consult together in kindness; but if ye make difficulties for one another, then let some other woman give suck for him (the father of the child).
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: لِيُنفِقْ ذُو سَعَةٍۢ مِّن سَعَتِهِۦ ۖ وَمَن قُدِرَ عَلَيْهِ رِزْقُهُۥ فَلْيُنفِقْ مِمَّآ ءَاتَىٰهُ ٱللَّهُ ۚ لَا يُكَلِّفُ ٱللَّهُ نَفْسًا إِلَّا مَآ ءَاتَىٰهَا ۚ سَيَجْعَلُ ٱللَّهُ بَعْدَ عُسْرٍۢ يُسْرًۭا
verses.translit: Liyuntiq zoo sa'atim min sa'atihee wa man qudira 'alaihi riquhoo falyunfiq mimmaaa aataahul laah; laa yukalliful laahu nafsan illaa maaa aataahaa; sa yaj'alul laahu ba'da'usriny yusraa
verses.translation: Let him who hath abundance spend of his abundance, and he whose provision is measured, let him spend of that which Allah hath given him. Allah asketh naught of any soul save that which He hath given it. Allah will vouchsafe, after hardship, ease.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَكَأَيِّن مِّن قَرْيَةٍ عَتَتْ عَنْ أَمْرِ رَبِّهَا وَرُسُلِهِۦ فَحَاسَبْنَٰهَا حِسَابًۭا شَدِيدًۭا وَعَذَّبْنَٰهَا عَذَابًۭا نُّكْرًۭا
verses.translit: Wa ka ayyim min qaryatin 'atat 'an amri Rabbihaa wa Rusulihee fahaasabnaahaa hisaaban shadeedanw wa 'azzabnaahaa 'azaaban nukraa
verses.translation: And how many a community revolted against the ordinance of its Lord and His messengers, and We called it to a stern account and punished it with dire punishment,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: فَذَاقَتْ وَبَالَ أَمْرِهَا وَكَانَ عَٰقِبَةُ أَمْرِهَا خُسْرًا
verses.translit: Fazaaqat wabbala amrihaa wa kaana 'aaqibatu amrihaa khusraa
verses.translation: So that it tasted the ill-effects of its conduct, and the consequence of its conduct was loss.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: أَعَدَّ ٱللَّهُ لَهُمْ عَذَابًۭا شَدِيدًۭا ۖ فَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ يَٰٓأُو۟لِى ٱلْأَلْبَٰبِ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ ۚ قَدْ أَنزَلَ ٱللَّهُ إِلَيْكُمْ ذِكْرًۭا
verses.translit: A'addal laahu lahum 'azaaban shadeedan fattaqul laaha yaaa ulil albaab, allazeena aammanoo; qad anzalal laahu ilaikum zikraa
verses.translation: Allah hath prepared for them stern punishment; so keep your duty to Allah, O men of understanding! O ye who believe! Now Allah hath sent down unto you a reminder,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: رَّسُولًۭا يَتْلُوا۟ عَلَيْكُمْ ءَايَٰتِ ٱللَّهِ مُبَيِّنَٰتٍۢ لِّيُخْرِجَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ مِنَ ٱلظُّلُمَٰتِ إِلَى ٱلنُّورِ ۚ وَمَن يُؤْمِنۢ بِٱللَّهِ وَيَعْمَلْ صَٰلِحًۭا يُدْخِلْهُ جَنَّٰتٍۢ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا ٱلْأَنْهَٰرُ خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَآ أَبَدًۭا ۖ قَدْ أَحْسَنَ ٱللَّهُ لَهُۥ رِزْقًا
verses.translit: Rasoolany yatloo 'alaikum aayaatil laahi mubaiyinaatil liyukhrijal lazeena aamanoo wa 'amilus saalihaati minaz zulumaati ilan noor; wa many yu'mim billaahi wa ya;mal saalihany yudkhilhu jannaatin tajree min tahtihal anhaaru khaalideena feehaa abadan qad ahsanal laahu lahoo rizqqq
verses.translation: A messenger reciting unto you the revelations of Allah made plain, that He may bring forth those who believe and do good works from darkness unto light. And whosoever believeth in Allah and doeth right, He will bring him into Gardens underneath which rivers flow, therein to abide for ever. Allah hath made good provision for him.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ سَبْعَ سَمَٰوَٰتٍۢ وَمِنَ ٱلْأَرْضِ مِثْلَهُنَّ يَتَنَزَّلُ ٱلْأَمْرُ بَيْنَهُنَّ لِتَعْلَمُوٓا۟ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍۢ قَدِيرٌۭ وَأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ قَدْ أَحَاطَ بِكُلِّ شَىْءٍ عِلْمًۢا
verses.translit: Allaahul lazee khalaq Sab'a Samaawaatinw wa minal ardi mislahunna yatanazzalul amru bainahunna lita'lamooo annal laaha 'alaa kulli shai'in Qadeerunw wa annal laaha qad ahaata bikulli shai'in ilmaa
verses.translation: Allah it is who hath created seven heavens, and of the earth the like thereof. The commandment cometh down among them slowly, that ye may know that Allah is Able to do all things, and that Allah surroundeth all things in knowledge.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّبِىُّ لِمَ تُحَرِّمُ مَآ أَحَلَّ ٱللَّهُ لَكَ ۖ تَبْتَغِى مَرْضَاتَ أَزْوَٰجِكَ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ غَفُورٌۭ رَّحِيمٌۭ
verses.translit: Yaaa ayyuhan nabiyyu lima tuharrimu maaa ahallal laahu laka tabtaghee mardaata azwaajik; wallaahu ghafoorur raheem
verses.translation: O Prophet! Why bannest thou that which Allah hath made lawful for thee, seeking to please thy wives? And Allah is Forgiving, Merciful.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: قَدْ فَرَضَ ٱللَّهُ لَكُمْ تَحِلَّةَ أَيْمَٰنِكُمْ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ مَوْلَىٰكُمْ ۖ وَهُوَ ٱلْعَلِيمُ ٱلْحَكِيمُ
verses.translit: Qad faradal laahu lakum tahillata aymaanikum; wallaahu mawlaakum wa huwal'aleemul hakeem
verses.translation: Allah hath made lawful for you (Muslims) absolution from your oaths (of such a kind), and Allah is your Protector. He is the Knower, the Wise.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَإِذْ أَسَرَّ ٱلنَّبِىُّ إِلَىٰ بَعْضِ أَزْوَٰجِهِۦ حَدِيثًۭا فَلَمَّا نَبَّأَتْ بِهِۦ وَأَظْهَرَهُ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ عَرَّفَ بَعْضَهُۥ وَأَعْرَضَ عَنۢ بَعْضٍۢ ۖ فَلَمَّا نَبَّأَهَا بِهِۦ قَالَتْ مَنْ أَنۢبَأَكَ هَٰذَا ۖ قَالَ نَبَّأَنِىَ ٱلْعَلِيمُ ٱلْخَبِيرُ
verses.translit: Wa iz asarran nabiyyu ilaa ba'di azwaajihee hadeesan falammaa nabba at bihee wa azharahul laahu 'alaihi 'arrafa ba'dahoo wa a'rada 'am ba'din falammaa nabba ahaa bihee qaalat man amba aka haaza qaala nabba aniyal 'aleemul khabeer
verses.translation: When the Prophet confided a fact unto one of his wives and when she afterward divulged it and Allah apprised him thereof, he made known (to her) part thereof and passed over part. And when he told it her she said: Who hath told thee? He said: The Knower, the Aware hath told me.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: إِن تَتُوبَآ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ فَقَدْ صَغَتْ قُلُوبُكُمَا ۖ وَإِن تَظَٰهَرَا عَلَيْهِ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ هُوَ مَوْلَىٰهُ وَجِبْرِيلُ وَصَٰلِحُ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ ۖ وَٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ بَعْدَ ذَٰلِكَ ظَهِيرٌ
verses.translit: In tatoobaaa ilal laahi faqad saghat quloobukumaa wa in tazaaharaa 'alihi fa innal laaha huwa mawlaahu wa jibreelu wa saalihul mu'mineen; walma laaa'ikatu ba'dazaalika zaheer
verses.translation: If ye twain turn unto Allah repentant, (ye have cause to do so) for your hearts desired (the ban); and if ye aid one another against him (Muhammad) then lo! Allah, even He, is his Protecting Friend, and Gabriel and the righteous among the believers; and furthermore the angels are his helpers.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: عَسَىٰ رَبُّهُۥٓ إِن طَلَّقَكُنَّ أَن يُبْدِلَهُۥٓ أَزْوَٰجًا خَيْرًۭا مِّنكُنَّ مُسْلِمَٰتٍۢ مُّؤْمِنَٰتٍۢ قَٰنِتَٰتٍۢ تَٰٓئِبَٰتٍ عَٰبِدَٰتٍۢ سَٰٓئِحَٰتٍۢ ثَيِّبَٰتٍۢ وَأَبْكَارًۭا
verses.translit: 'Asaa rabbuhooo in tallaqakunna anyyubdilahooo azwaajan khairam mnkunna muslimaatim mu'minaatin qaanitaatin taaa'ibaatin 'aabidaatin saaa'ihaatin saiyibaatinw wa abkaaraa
verses.translation: It may happen that his Lord, if he divorce you, will give him in your stead wives better than you, submissive (to Allah), believing, pious, penitent, devout, inclined to fasting, widows and maids.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ قُوٓا۟ أَنفُسَكُمْ وَأَهْلِيكُمْ نَارًۭا وَقُودُهَا ٱلنَّاسُ وَٱلْحِجَارَةُ عَلَيْهَا مَلَٰٓئِكَةٌ غِلَاظٌۭ شِدَادٌۭ لَّا يَعْصُونَ ٱللَّهَ مَآ أَمَرَهُمْ وَيَفْعَلُونَ مَا يُؤْمَرُونَ
verses.translit: Yaaa ayyuhal lazeena samanoo qooo anfusakum wa ahleekum naaranw waqoodu han naasu wal hijaaratu 'alaihaa malaaa'ikatun ghilaazun shidaadul laa ya'soonal laaha maa amarahum wa yaf'aloona maa yu'maroon
verses.translation: O ye who believe! Ward off from yourselves and your families a Fire whereof the fuel is men and stones, over which are set angels strong, severe, who resist not Allah in that which He commandeth them, but do that which they are commanded.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لَا تَعْتَذِرُوا۟ ٱلْيَوْمَ ۖ إِنَّمَا تُجْزَوْنَ مَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ
verses.translit: Yaaa ayyuhal lazeena kafaroo la ta'tazinul yawma innamaa tujzawna maa kuntum ta'maloon
verses.translation: (Then it will be said): O ye who disbelieve! Make no excuses for yourselves this day. Ye are only being paid for what ye used to do.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ تُوبُوٓا۟ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ تَوْبَةًۭ نَّصُوحًا عَسَىٰ رَبُّكُمْ أَن يُكَفِّرَ عَنكُمْ سَيِّـَٔاتِكُمْ وَيُدْخِلَكُمْ جَنَّٰتٍۢ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا ٱلْأَنْهَٰرُ يَوْمَ لَا يُخْزِى ٱللَّهُ ٱلنَّبِىَّ وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ مَعَهُۥ ۖ نُورُهُمْ يَسْعَىٰ بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَبِأَيْمَٰنِهِمْ يَقُولُونَ رَبَّنَآ أَتْمِمْ لَنَا نُورَنَا وَٱغْفِرْ لَنَآ ۖ إِنَّكَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍۢ قَدِيرٌۭ
verses.translit: Yaaa ayyuhal lazeena aammano toobooo ilal laahi tawbatan nasoohan 'asaa rabbukum any-yukaffira 'ankum sayyi aatikum wa yudkhilakum jannaatin tajree min tahtihal anhaaru yawma laa yukhzil laahun nabiyya wallazeena aamanoo ma'ahoo nooruhum yas'aa baina aydeehim wa bi aymaanihim yaqooloona rabbanaaa atmim lanaa nooranaa waghfir lana innaka 'alaa kulli shai'in qadeer
verses.translation: O ye who believe! Turn unto Allah in sincere repentance! It may be that your Lord will remit from you your evil deeds and bring you into Gardens underneath which rivers flow, on the day when Allah will not abase the Prophet and those who believe with him. Their light will run before them and on their right hands; they will say: Our Lord! Perfect our light for us, and forgive us! Lo! Thou art Able to do all things.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّبِىُّ جَٰهِدِ ٱلْكُفَّارَ وَٱلْمُنَٰفِقِينَ وَٱغْلُظْ عَلَيْهِمْ ۚ وَمَأْوَىٰهُمْ جَهَنَّمُ ۖ وَبِئْسَ ٱلْمَصِيرُ
verses.translit: yaaa ayyuuhan nabiyyu jaahidil kuffaara walmunaa-fiqeena waghluz 'alaihim; wa maawaahum jahannamu wa bi'sal maseer
verses.translation: O Prophet! Strive against the disbelievers and the hypocrites, and be stern with them. Hell will be their home, a hapless journey's end.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: ضَرَبَ ٱللَّهُ مَثَلًۭا لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ ٱمْرَأَتَ نُوحٍۢ وَٱمْرَأَتَ لُوطٍۢ ۖ كَانَتَا تَحْتَ عَبْدَيْنِ مِنْ عِبَادِنَا صَٰلِحَيْنِ فَخَانَتَاهُمَا فَلَمْ يُغْنِيَا عَنْهُمَا مِنَ ٱللَّهِ شَيْـًۭٔا وَقِيلَ ٱدْخُلَا ٱلنَّارَ مَعَ ٱلدَّٰخِلِينَ
verses.translit: Darabal laahu masalal lillazeena kafarum ra ata Noobinw wamra ata Loot, kaanataa tahta 'abdaini min 'ibaadinaa saalihaini fakhaanataahumaa falam yughniyaa 'anhumaa minal laahi shai anw-wa qeelad khulan naara ma'ad Daakhileen
verses.translation: Allah citeth an example for those who disbelieve: the wife of Noah and the wife of Lot, who were under two of Our righteous slaves yet betrayed them so that they (the husbands) availed them naught against Allah and it was said (unto them): Enter the Fire along with those who enter.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَضَرَبَ ٱللَّهُ مَثَلًۭا لِّلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ ٱمْرَأَتَ فِرْعَوْنَ إِذْ قَالَتْ رَبِّ ٱبْنِ لِى عِندَكَ بَيْتًۭا فِى ٱلْجَنَّةِ وَنَجِّنِى مِن فِرْعَوْنَ وَعَمَلِهِۦ وَنَجِّنِى مِنَ ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ
verses.translit: Wa darabal laahu masa lal-lillazeena aamanumra ata Fir'awn; iz qaalat rabbibni lee 'indaka baitan fil jannati wa najjinee min Fir'awna wa 'amalihii wa najjinee minal qawmiz zaalimeen
verses.translation: And Allah citeth an example for those who believe: the wife of Pharaoh when she said: My Lord! Build for me a home with thee in the Garden, and deliver me from Pharaoh and his work, and deliver me from evil-doing folk;
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَمَرْيَمَ ٱبْنَتَ عِمْرَٰنَ ٱلَّتِىٓ أَحْصَنَتْ فَرْجَهَا فَنَفَخْنَا فِيهِ مِن رُّوحِنَا وَصَدَّقَتْ بِكَلِمَٰتِ رَبِّهَا وَكُتُبِهِۦ وَكَانَتْ مِنَ ٱلْقَٰنِتِينَ
verses.translit: Wa Maryamab nata 'Imraanal lateee ahsanat farjahaa fanafakhnaa feehi mir roobinaa wa saddaqat bikali maati Rabbihaa wa Kutubihee wakaanat minal qaaniteen
verses.translation: And Mary, daughter of 'Imran, whose body was chaste, therefor We breathed therein something of Our Spirit. And she put faith in the words of her Lord and His scriptures, and was of the obedient.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ تَبَٰرَكَ ٱلَّذِى بِيَدِهِ ٱلْمُلْكُ وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍۢ قَدِيرٌ
verses.translit: Tabaarakal lazee biyadihil mulku wa huwa 'alaa kulli shai-in qadeer
verses.translation: Blessed is He in Whose hand is the Sovereignty, and, He is Able to do all things.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ ٱلْمَوْتَ وَٱلْحَيَوٰةَ لِيَبْلُوَكُمْ أَيُّكُمْ أَحْسَنُ عَمَلًۭا ۚ وَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْغَفُورُ
verses.translit: Allazee khalaqal mawta walhayaata liyabluwakum ayyukum ahsanu 'amalaa; wa huwal 'azeezul ghafoor
verses.translation: Who hath created life and death that He may try you which of you is best in conduct; and He is the Mighty, the Forgiving,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ سَبْعَ سَمَٰوَٰتٍۢ طِبَاقًۭا ۖ مَّا تَرَىٰ فِى خَلْقِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ مِن تَفَٰوُتٍۢ ۖ فَٱرْجِعِ ٱلْبَصَرَ هَلْ تَرَىٰ مِن فُطُورٍۢ
verses.translit: Allazee khalaqa sab'a samaawaatin tibaaqam maa taraa fee khalqir rahmaani min tafaawutin farji'il basara hal taraa min futoor
verses.translation: Who hath created seven heavens in harmony. Thou (Muhammad) canst see no fault in the Beneficent One's creation; then look again: Canst thou see any rifts?
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: ثُمَّ ٱرْجِعِ ٱلْبَصَرَ كَرَّتَيْنِ يَنقَلِبْ إِلَيْكَ ٱلْبَصَرُ خَاسِئًۭا وَهُوَ حَسِيرٌۭ
verses.translit: Summar ji'il basara karrataini yanqalib ilaikal basaru khaasi'anw wa huwa haseer
verses.translation: Then look again and yet again, thy sight will return unto thee weakened and made dim.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَلَقَدْ زَيَّنَّا ٱلسَّمَآءَ ٱلدُّنْيَا بِمَصَٰبِيحَ وَجَعَلْنَٰهَا رُجُومًۭا لِّلشَّيَٰطِينِ ۖ وَأَعْتَدْنَا لَهُمْ عَذَابَ ٱلسَّعِيرِ
verses.translit: Wa laqad zaiyannas samaaa'ad dunyaa bimasaa beeha wa ja'alnaahaa rujoomal lish shayaateeni wa a'tadnaa lahum 'azaabas sa'eer
verses.translation: And verily We have beautified the world's heaven with lamps, and We have made them missiles for the devils, and for them We have prepared the doom of flame.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَلِلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ بِرَبِّهِمْ عَذَابُ جَهَنَّمَ ۖ وَبِئْسَ ٱلْمَصِيرُ
verses.translit: Wa lillazeena kafaroo bi rabbihim 'azaabu jahannama wa bi'sal maseer
verses.translation: And for those who disbelieve in their Lord there is the doom of hell, a hapless journey's end!
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: إِذَآ أُلْقُوا۟ فِيهَا سَمِعُوا۟ لَهَا شَهِيقًۭا وَهِىَ تَفُورُ
verses.translit: Izaaa ulqoo feehaa sami'oo lahaa shaheeqanw wa hiya tafoor
verses.translation: When they are flung therein they hear its roaring as it boileth up,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: تَكَادُ تَمَيَّزُ مِنَ ٱلْغَيْظِ ۖ كُلَّمَآ أُلْقِىَ فِيهَا فَوْجٌۭ سَأَلَهُمْ خَزَنَتُهَآ أَلَمْ يَأْتِكُمْ نَذِيرٌۭ
verses.translit: Takaadu tamayyazu minal ghaizi kullamaaa uliqya feehaa fawjun sa alahum khazanatuhaaa alam yaatikum nazeer
verses.translation: As it would burst with rage. Whenever a (fresh) host is flung therein the wardens thereof ask them: Came there unto you no warner?
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: قَالُوا۟ بَلَىٰ قَدْ جَآءَنَا نَذِيرٌۭ فَكَذَّبْنَا وَقُلْنَا مَا نَزَّلَ ٱللَّهُ مِن شَىْءٍ إِنْ أَنتُمْ إِلَّا فِى ضَلَٰلٍۢ كَبِيرٍۢ
verses.translit: Qaaloo balaa qad jaaa'anaa nazeerun fakazzabnaa wa qulnaa maa nazzalal laahu min shai in in antum illaa fee dalaalin kabeer
verses.translation: They say: Yea, verily, a warner came unto us; but we denied and said: Allah hath naught revealed; ye are in naught but a great error.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَقَالُوا۟ لَوْ كُنَّا نَسْمَعُ أَوْ نَعْقِلُ مَا كُنَّا فِىٓ أَصْحَٰبِ ٱلسَّعِيرِ
verses.translit: Wa qaaloo law kunnaa nasma'u awna'qilu maa kunnaa feee as haabis sa'eer
verses.translation: And they say: Had we been wont to listen or have sense, we had not been among the dwellers in the flames.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translit: Fa'tarafoo bizambihim fasuhqal li as haabis sa'eer
verses.translation: So they acknowledge their sins; but far removed (from mercy) are the dwellers in the flames.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يَخْشَوْنَ رَبَّهُم بِٱلْغَيْبِ لَهُم مَّغْفِرَةٌۭ وَأَجْرٌۭ كَبِيرٌۭ
verses.translit: Innal lazeena yakhshawna rabbahum bilghaibi lahum maghfiratunw wa ajrun kabeer
verses.translation: Lo! those who fear their Lord in secret, theirs will be forgiveness and a great reward.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَأَسِرُّوا۟ قَوْلَكُمْ أَوِ ٱجْهَرُوا۟ بِهِۦٓ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ عَلِيمٌۢ بِذَاتِ ٱلصُّدُورِ
verses.translit: Wa asirroo qawlakum awijharoo bihee innahoo 'aleemum bizaatis sudoor
verses.translation: And keep your opinion secret or proclaim it, lo! He is Knower of all that is in the breasts (of men).
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: أَلَا يَعْلَمُ مَنْ خَلَقَ وَهُوَ ٱللَّطِيفُ ٱلْخَبِيرُ
verses.translit: Alaa ya'lamu man khalaq wa huwal lateeful khabeer
verses.translation: Should He not know what He created? And He is the Subtile, the Aware.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: هُوَ ٱلَّذِى جَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلْأَرْضَ ذَلُولًۭا فَٱمْشُوا۟ فِى مَنَاكِبِهَا وَكُلُوا۟ مِن رِّزْقِهِۦ ۖ وَإِلَيْهِ ٱلنُّشُورُ
verses.translit: Huwal lazee ja'ala lakumul arda zaloolan famshoo fee manaakibihaa wa kuloo mir rizqihee wa ilaihin nushoor
verses.translation: He it is Who hath made the earth subservient unto you, so Walk in the paths thereof and eat of His providence. And unto Him will be the resurrection (of the dead).
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: ءَأَمِنتُم مَّن فِى ٱلسَّمَآءِ أَن يَخْسِفَ بِكُمُ ٱلْأَرْضَ فَإِذَا هِىَ تَمُورُ
verses.translit: 'A-amintum man fissamaaa'i aiyakhsifa bi kumul arda fa izaa hiya tamoor
verses.translation: Have ye taken security from Him Who is in the heaven that He will not cause the earth to swallow you when lo! it is convulsed?
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: أَمْ أَمِنتُم مَّن فِى ٱلسَّمَآءِ أَن يُرْسِلَ عَلَيْكُمْ حَاصِبًۭا ۖ فَسَتَعْلَمُونَ كَيْفَ نَذِيرِ
verses.translit: Am amintum man fissamaaa'i ai yursila 'alaikum haasiban fasata'lamoona kaifa nazeer
verses.translation: Or have ye taken security from Him Who is in the heaven that He will not let loose on you a hurricane? But ye shall know the manner of My warning.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَلَقَدْ كَذَّبَ ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ فَكَيْفَ كَانَ نَكِيرِ
verses.translit: Wa laqad kazzabal lazeena min qablihim fakaifa kaana nakeer
verses.translation: And verily those before them denied, then (see) the manner of My wrath (with them)!
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: أَوَلَمْ يَرَوْا۟ إِلَى ٱلطَّيْرِ فَوْقَهُمْ صَٰٓفَّٰتٍۢ وَيَقْبِضْنَ ۚ مَا يُمْسِكُهُنَّ إِلَّا ٱلرَّحْمَٰنُ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ بِكُلِّ شَىْءٍۭ بَصِيرٌ
verses.translit: Awalam yaraw ilat tairi fawqahum saaaffaatinw wa yaqbidn; maa yumsikuhunna illaar rahmaan; innahoo bikulli shai im baseer
verses.translation: Have they not seen the birds above them spreading out their wings and closing them? Naught upholdeth them save the Beneficent. Lo! He is Seer of all things.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: أَمَّنْ هَٰذَا ٱلَّذِى هُوَ جُندٌۭ لَّكُمْ يَنصُرُكُم مِّن دُونِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ۚ إِنِ ٱلْكَٰفِرُونَ إِلَّا فِى غُرُورٍ
verses.translit: Amman haazal lazee huwa jundul lakum yansurukum min doonir rahmaan; inilkaafiroona illaa fee ghuroor
verses.translation: Or who is he that will be an army unto you to help you instead of the Beneficent? The disbelievers are in naught but illusion.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: أَمَّنْ هَٰذَا ٱلَّذِى يَرْزُقُكُمْ إِنْ أَمْسَكَ رِزْقَهُۥ ۚ بَل لَّجُّوا۟ فِى عُتُوٍّۢ وَنُفُورٍ
verses.translit: Amman haazal lazee yarzuqukum in amsaka rizqah; bal lajjoo fee 'utuwwinw wa nufoor
verses.translation: Or who is he that will provide for you if He should withhold His providence? Nay, but they are set in pride and frowardness.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: أَفَمَن يَمْشِى مُكِبًّا عَلَىٰ وَجْهِهِۦٓ أَهْدَىٰٓ أَمَّن يَمْشِى سَوِيًّا عَلَىٰ صِرَٰطٍۢ مُّسْتَقِيمٍۢ
verses.translit: Afamai yamshee mukibban 'alaa wajhihee ahdaaa ammany yamshee sawiyyan 'alaa siratim mustaqeem
verses.translation: Is he who goeth groping on his face more rightly guided, or he who walketh upright on a straight road?
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: قُلْ هُوَ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَنشَأَكُمْ وَجَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلسَّمْعَ وَٱلْأَبْصَٰرَ وَٱلْأَفْـِٔدَةَ ۖ قَلِيلًۭا مَّا تَشْكُرُونَ
verses.translit: Qul huwal lazee ansha akum wa ja'ala lakumus sam'a wal absaara wal af'idata qaleelam maa tashkuroon
verses.translation: Say (unto them, O Muhammad): He it is who gave you being, and hath assigned unto you ears and eyes and hearts. Small thanks give ye!
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: قُلْ هُوَ ٱلَّذِى ذَرَأَكُمْ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَإِلَيْهِ تُحْشَرُونَ
verses.translit: Qul huwal lazee zara akum fil ardi wa ilaihi tuhsharoon
verses.translation: Say: He it is Who multiplieth you in the earth, and unto Whom ye will be gathered.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَيَقُولُونَ مَتَىٰ هَٰذَا ٱلْوَعْدُ إِن كُنتُمْ صَٰدِقِينَ
verses.translit: Wa yaqooloona mataa haazal wa'du in kuntum saadiqeen
verses.translation: And they say: When (will) this promise (be fulfilled), if ye are truthful?
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: قُلْ إِنَّمَا ٱلْعِلْمُ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ وَإِنَّمَآ أَنَا۠ نَذِيرٌۭ مُّبِينٌۭ
verses.translit: Qul innamal 'ilmu 'indallaahi wa innamaaa ana nazeerum mubeen
verses.translation: Say: The knowledge is with Allah only, and I am but a plain warner;
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: فَلَمَّا رَأَوْهُ زُلْفَةًۭ سِيٓـَٔتْ وُجُوهُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ وَقِيلَ هَٰذَا ٱلَّذِى كُنتُم بِهِۦ تَدَّعُونَ
verses.translit: Falaammaa ra-awhu zulfatan seee'at wujoohul lazeena kafaroo wa qeela haazal lazee kuntum bihee tadda'oon
verses.translation: But when they see it nigh, the faces of those who disbelieve will be awry, and it will be said (unto them): This is that for which ye used to call.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: قُلْ أَرَءَيْتُمْ إِنْ أَهْلَكَنِىَ ٱللَّهُ وَمَن مَّعِىَ أَوْ رَحِمَنَا فَمَن يُجِيرُ ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ مِنْ عَذَابٍ أَلِيمٍۢ
verses.translit: Qul ara'aytum in ahlaka niyal laahu wa mam ma'iya aw rahimanaa famai-yujeerul kaafireena min 'azaabin aleem
verses.translation: Say (O Muhammad): Have ye thought: Whether Allah causeth me (Muhammad) and those with me to perish or hath mercy on us, still, who will protect the disbelievers from a painful doom?
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: قُلْ هُوَ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنُ ءَامَنَّا بِهِۦ وَعَلَيْهِ تَوَكَّلْنَا ۖ فَسَتَعْلَمُونَ مَنْ هُوَ فِى ضَلَٰلٍۢ مُّبِينٍۢ
verses.translit: Qul huwar rahmaanu aamannaa bihee wa 'alaihi tawakkalnaa fasata'lamoona man huwa fee dalaalim mubeen
verses.translation: Say: He is the Beneficent. In Him we believe and in Him we put our trust. And ye will soon know who it is that is in error manifest.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: قُلْ أَرَءَيْتُمْ إِنْ أَصْبَحَ مَآؤُكُمْ غَوْرًۭا فَمَن يَأْتِيكُم بِمَآءٍۢ مَّعِينٍۭ
verses.translit: Qul ara'aytum in asbaha maaa'ukum ghawran famai yaateekum bimaaa'im ma'een
verses.translation: Say: Have ye thought: If (all) your water were to disappear into the earth, who then could bring you gushing water?
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ نٓ ۚ وَٱلْقَلَمِ وَمَا يَسْطُرُونَ
verses.translation: Nun. By the pen and that which they write (therewith),
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: Thou art not, for thy Lord's favour unto thee, a madman.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translit: Wa inna laka la ajran ghaira mamnoon
verses.translation: And lo! thine verily will be a reward unfailing.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: And lo! thou art of a tremendous nature.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: And thou wilt see and they will see
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: Which of you is the demented.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: إِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِمَن ضَلَّ عَن سَبِيلِهِۦ وَهُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِٱلْمُهْتَدِينَ
verses.translit: Innaa Rabbaka Huwa a'lamu biman dalla 'an sabeelihee wa Huwa a'lamu bilmuhtadeen
verses.translation: Lo! thy Lord is Best Aware of him who strayeth from His way, and He is Best Aware of those who walk aright.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: Therefor obey not thou the rejecters
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: Who would have had thee compromise, that they may compromise.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translit: Wa laa tuti' kulla hallaa fim maheen
verses.translation: Neither obey thou each feeble oath-monger,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: Detracter, spreader abroad of slanders,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: Hinderer of the good, transgressor, malefactor
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: Greedy therewithal, intrusive.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: It is because he is possessed of wealth and children
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: إِذَا تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْهِ ءَايَٰتُنَا قَالَ أَسَٰطِيرُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
verses.translit: Izaa tutlaa 'alaihi aayaatunaa qaala asaateerul awwaleen
verses.translation: That, when Our revelations are recited unto him, he saith: Mere fables of the men of old.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: We shall brand him on the nose.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: إِنَّا بَلَوْنَٰهُمْ كَمَا بَلَوْنَآ أَصْحَٰبَ ٱلْجَنَّةِ إِذْ أَقْسَمُوا۟ لَيَصْرِمُنَّهَا مُصْبِحِينَ
verses.translit: Innaa balawnaahum kamaa balawnaaa As-haabal jannati iz 'aqsamoo la-yasri munnahaa musbiheen
verses.translation: Lo! We have tried them as We tried the owners of the garden when they vowed that they would pluck its fruit next morning,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: And made no exception (for the Will of Allah);
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: فَطَافَ عَلَيْهَا طَآئِفٌۭ مِّن رَّبِّكَ وَهُمْ نَآئِمُونَ
verses.translit: Fataafa 'alaihaa taaa'i fum mir rabbika wa hum naaa'imoon
verses.translation: Then a visitation from thy Lord came upon it while they slept
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: And in the morning it was as if plucked.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: And they cried out one unto another in the morning,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: أَنِ ٱغْدُوا۟ عَلَىٰ حَرْثِكُمْ إِن كُنتُمْ صَٰرِمِينَ
verses.translation: Saying: Run unto your field if ye would pluck (the fruit).
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: So they went off, saying one unto another in low tones:
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: أَن لَّا يَدْخُلَنَّهَا ٱلْيَوْمَ عَلَيْكُم مِّسْكِينٌۭ
verses.translation: No needy man shall enter it to-day against you.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: They went betimes, strong in (this) purpose.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translit: Falammaa ra awhaa qaalooo innaa ladaaalloon
verses.translation: But when they saw it, they said: Lo! we are in error!
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: Nay, but we are desolate!
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: قَالَ أَوْسَطُهُمْ أَلَمْ أَقُل لَّكُمْ لَوْلَا تُسَبِّحُونَ
verses.translit: Qaala awsatuhum alam aqul lakum law laa tusabbihoon
verses.translation: The best among them said: Said I not unto you: Why glorify ye not (Allah)?
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: قَالُوا۟ سُبْحَٰنَ رَبِّنَآ إِنَّا كُنَّا ظَٰلِمِينَ
verses.translit: Qaaloo subhaana rabbinaaa innaa kunnaa zaalimeen
verses.translation: They said: Glorified be our Lord! Lo! we have been wrong-doers.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: Then some of them drew near unto others, self-reproaching.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translit: Qaaloo yaa wailanaaa innaa kunnaa taagheen
verses.translation: They said: Alas for us! In truth we were outrageous.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: عَسَىٰ رَبُّنَآ أَن يُبْدِلَنَا خَيْرًۭا مِّنْهَآ إِنَّآ إِلَىٰ رَبِّنَا رَٰغِبُونَ
verses.translit: 'Asaa rabbunaaa any yubdilanaa khairam minhaaa innaaa ilaa rabbinaa raaghiboon
verses.translation: It may be that our Lord will give us better than this in place thereof. Lo! we beseech our Lord.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: كَذَٰلِكَ ٱلْعَذَابُ ۖ وَلَعَذَابُ ٱلْءَاخِرَةِ أَكْبَرُ ۚ لَوْ كَانُوا۟ يَعْلَمُونَ
verses.translit: Kazaalikal azaab, wa la'azaabul aakhirati akbar; law kaanoo ya'lamoon
verses.translation: Such was the punishment. And verily the punishment of the Hereafter is greater if they did but know.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: إِنَّ لِلْمُتَّقِينَ عِندَ رَبِّهِمْ جَنَّٰتِ ٱلنَّعِيمِ
verses.translation: Lo! for those who keep from evil are gardens of bliss with their Lord.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: Shall We then treat those who have surrendered as We treat the guilty?
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: What aileth you? How foolishly ye judge!
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: Or have ye a scripture wherein ye learn
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: That ye shall indeed have all that ye choose?
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: أَمْ لَكُمْ أَيْمَٰنٌ عَلَيْنَا بَٰلِغَةٌ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ ۙ إِنَّ لَكُمْ لَمَا تَحْكُمُونَ
verses.translit: Am lakum aymaanun 'alainaa baalighatun ilaa yawmil qiyaamati inna lakum lamaa tahkumoon
verses.translation: Or have ye a covenant on oath from Us that reacheth to the Day of Judgment, that yours shall be all that ye ordain?
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: Ask them (O Muhammad) which of them will vouch for that!
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: أَمْ لَهُمْ شُرَكَآءُ فَلْيَأْتُوا۟ بِشُرَكَآئِهِمْ إِن كَانُوا۟ صَٰدِقِينَ
verses.translit: Am lahum shurakaaa'u falyaatoo bishurakaaa 'ihim in kaanoo saadiqeen
verses.translation: Or have they other gods? Then let them bring their other gods if they are truthful
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: يَوْمَ يُكْشَفُ عَن سَاقٍۢ وَيُدْعَوْنَ إِلَى ٱلسُّجُودِ فَلَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ
verses.translit: Yawma yukshafu 'am saaqinw wa yud'awna ilas sujoodi falaa yastatee'oon
verses.translation: On the day when it befalleth in earnest, and they are ordered to prostrate themselves but are not able,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: خَٰشِعَةً أَبْصَٰرُهُمْ تَرْهَقُهُمْ ذِلَّةٌۭ ۖ وَقَدْ كَانُوا۟ يُدْعَوْنَ إِلَى ٱلسُّجُودِ وَهُمْ سَٰلِمُونَ
verses.translit: Khaashi'atan absaaruhum tarhaquhum zillatunw wa qad kaanoo yud'awna ilassujoodi wa hum saalimoon
verses.translation: With eyes downcast, abasement stupefying them. And they had been summoned to prostrate themselves while they were yet unhurt.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: فَذَرْنِى وَمَن يُكَذِّبُ بِهَٰذَا ٱلْحَدِيثِ ۖ سَنَسْتَدْرِجُهُم مِّنْ حَيْثُ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
verses.translit: Fazarnee wa many yukazzibu bihaazal hadeesi sanastad rijuhum min haisu laa ya'lamoon
verses.translation: Leave Me (to deal) with those who give the lie to this pronouncement. We shall lead them on by steps from whence they know not.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translit: Wa umlee lahum; inna kaidee mateen
verses.translation: Yet I bear with them, for lo! My scheme is firm.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: أَمْ تَسْـَٔلُهُمْ أَجْرًۭا فَهُم مِّن مَّغْرَمٍۢ مُّثْقَلُونَ
verses.translit: Am tas'aluhum ajran fahum mim maghramim musqaloon
verses.translation: Or dost thou (Muhammad) ask a fee from them so that they are heavily taxed?
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: Or is the Unseen theirs that they can write (thereof)?
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: فَٱصْبِرْ لِحُكْمِ رَبِّكَ وَلَا تَكُن كَصَاحِبِ ٱلْحُوتِ إِذْ نَادَىٰ وَهُوَ مَكْظُومٌۭ
verses.translit: Fasbir lihkmi rabbika wa laa takun kasaahibil boot; iz naadaa wa huwa makzoom
verses.translation: But wait thou for thy Lord's decree, and be not like him of the fish, who cried out in despair.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: لَّوْلَآ أَن تَدَٰرَكَهُۥ نِعْمَةٌۭ مِّن رَّبِّهِۦ لَنُبِذَ بِٱلْعَرَآءِ وَهُوَ مَذْمُومٌۭ
verses.translit: Law laaa an tadaara kahoo ni'matum mir rabbihee lanubiza bil'araaa'i wa huwa mazmoom
verses.translation: Had it not been that favour from his Lord had reached him he surely had been cast into the wilderness while he was reprobate.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: But his Lord chose him and placed him among the righteous.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَإِن يَكَادُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لَيُزْلِقُونَكَ بِأَبْصَٰرِهِمْ لَمَّا سَمِعُوا۟ ٱلذِّكْرَ وَيَقُولُونَ إِنَّهُۥ لَمَجْنُونٌۭ
verses.translit: Wa iny-yakaadul lazeena kafaroo la-yuzliqoonaka biabsaarihim lammaa saml'uz-Zikra wa yaqooloona innahoo lamajnoon
verses.translation: And lo! those who disbelieve would fain disconcert thee with their eyes when they hear the Reminder, and they say: Lo! he is indeed mad;
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translit: Wa maa huwa illaa zikrul lil'aalameen
verses.translation: When it is naught else than a Reminder to creation.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: The Reality!
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: What is the Reality?
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: Ah, what will convey unto thee what the reality is!
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: (The tribes of) Thamud and A'ad disbelieved in the judgment to come.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: As for Thamud, they were destroyed by the lightning.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَأَمَّا عَادٌۭ فَأُهْلِكُوا۟ بِرِيحٍۢ صَرْصَرٍ عَاتِيَةٍۢ
verses.translit: Wa ammaa 'Aadun fa uhlikoo bireehin sarsarin 'aatiyah
verses.translation: And as for A'ad, they were destroyed by a fierce roaring wind,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: سَخَّرَهَا عَلَيْهِمْ سَبْعَ لَيَالٍۢ وَثَمَٰنِيَةَ أَيَّامٍ حُسُومًۭا فَتَرَى ٱلْقَوْمَ فِيهَا صَرْعَىٰ كَأَنَّهُمْ أَعْجَازُ نَخْلٍ خَاوِيَةٍۢ
verses.translit: Sakhkharahaa 'alaihim sab'a la yaalinw wa samaaniyata ayyaamin husooman fataral qawma feehaa sar'aa ka annahum a'jaazu nakhlin khaawiyah
verses.translation: Which He imposed on them for seven long nights and eight long days so that thou mightest have seen men lying overthrown, as they were hollow trunks of palm-trees.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: Canst thou (O Muhammad) see any remnant of them?
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَجَآءَ فِرْعَوْنُ وَمَن قَبْلَهُۥ وَٱلْمُؤْتَفِكَٰتُ بِٱلْخَاطِئَةِ
verses.translit: Wa jaaa'a Firawnu wa man qablahoo wal mu'tafikaatu bilhaati'ah
verses.translation: And Pharaoh and those before him, and the communities that were destroyed, brought error,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: فَعَصَوْا۟ رَسُولَ رَبِّهِمْ فَأَخَذَهُمْ أَخْذَةًۭ رَّابِيَةً
verses.translit: Fa'ansaw Rasoola Rabbihim fa akhazahum akhzatar raabiyah
verses.translation: And they disobeyed the messenger of their Lord, therefor did He grip them with a tightening grip.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: إِنَّا لَمَّا طَغَا ٱلْمَآءُ حَمَلْنَٰكُمْ فِى ٱلْجَارِيَةِ
verses.translit: Innaa lammaa taghal maaa'u hamalnaakum fil jaariyah
verses.translation: Lo! when the waters rose, We carried you upon the ship
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: لِنَجْعَلَهَا لَكُمْ تَذْكِرَةًۭ وَتَعِيَهَآ أُذُنٌۭ وَٰعِيَةٌۭ
verses.translit: Linaj'alahaa lakum tazki ratanw-wa ta'iyahaa unzununw waa'iyah
verses.translation: That We might make it a memorial for you, and that remembering ears (that heard the story) might remember.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: فَإِذَا نُفِخَ فِى ٱلصُّورِ نَفْخَةٌۭ وَٰحِدَةٌۭ
verses.translit: Fa izaa nufikha fis soori nafkhatunw waahidah
verses.translation: And when the trumpet shall sound one blast
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَحُمِلَتِ ٱلْأَرْضُ وَٱلْجِبَالُ فَدُكَّتَا دَكَّةًۭ وَٰحِدَةًۭ
verses.translit: Wa humilatil ardu wal jibaalu fadukkataa dakkatanw waahidah
verses.translation: And the earth with the mountains shall be lifted up and crushed with one crash,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: Then, on that day will the Event befall.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: And the heaven will split asunder, for that day it will be frail.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَٱلْمَلَكُ عَلَىٰٓ أَرْجَآئِهَا ۚ وَيَحْمِلُ عَرْشَ رَبِّكَ فَوْقَهُمْ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ ثَمَٰنِيَةٌۭ
verses.translit: Wal malaku 'alaaa arjaaa'ihaa; wa yahmilu 'Arsha Rabbika fawqahum yawma'izin samaaniyah
verses.translation: And the angels will be on the sides thereof, and eight will uphold the Throne of thy Lord that day, above them.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: يَوْمَئِذٍۢ تُعْرَضُونَ لَا تَخْفَىٰ مِنكُمْ خَافِيَةٌۭ
verses.translit: Yawma'izin tu'radoona laa takhfaa min kum khaafiyah
verses.translation: On that day ye will be exposed; not a secret of you will be hidden.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: فَأَمَّا مَنْ أُوتِىَ كِتَٰبَهُۥ بِيَمِينِهِۦ فَيَقُولُ هَآؤُمُ ٱقْرَءُوا۟ كِتَٰبِيَهْ
verses.translit: Fa ammaa man ootiya kitaabahoo biyameenihee fa yaqoolu haaa'umuq ra'oo kitaabiyah
verses.translation: Then, as for him who is given his record in his right hand, he will say: Take, read my book!
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: Surely I knew that I should have to meet my reckoning.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: Then he will be in blissful state
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: In a high garden
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: Whereof the clusters are in easy reach.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: كُلُوا۟ وَٱشْرَبُوا۟ هَنِيٓـًٔۢا بِمَآ أَسْلَفْتُمْ فِى ٱلْأَيَّامِ ٱلْخَالِيَةِ
verses.translit: Kuloo washraboo haneee'am bimaaa aslaftum fil ayyaamil khaliyah
verses.translation: (And it will be said unto those therein): Eat and drink at ease for that which ye sent on before you in past days.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَأَمَّا مَنْ أُوتِىَ كِتَٰبَهُۥ بِشِمَالِهِۦ فَيَقُولُ يَٰلَيْتَنِى لَمْ أُوتَ كِتَٰبِيَهْ
verses.translit: Wa ammaa man ootiya kitaabahoo bishimaalihee fa yaqoolu yaalaitanee lam oota kitaaabiyah
verses.translation: But as for him who is given his record in his left hand, he will say: Oh, would that I had not been given my book
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: And knew not what my reckoning!
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: Oh, would that it had been death!
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: My wealth hath not availed me,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: My power hath gone from me.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: (It will be said): Take him and fetter him
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: And then expose him to hell-fire
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: ثُمَّ فِى سِلْسِلَةٍۢ ذَرْعُهَا سَبْعُونَ ذِرَاعًۭا فَٱسْلُكُوهُ
verses.translit: Summa fee silsilatin zar'uhaa sab'oona ziraa'an faslukooh
verses.translation: And then insert him in a chain whereof the length is seventy cubits.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ لَا يُؤْمِنُ بِٱللَّهِ ٱلْعَظِيمِ
verses.translation: Lo! He used not to believe in Allah the Tremendous,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: And urged not on the feeding of the wretched.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: Therefor hath he no lover here this day,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translit: Wa laa ta'aamun illaa min ghisleen
verses.translation: Nor any food save filth
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: Which none but sinners eat.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: But nay! I swear by all that ye see
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: And all that ye see not
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: That it is indeed the speech of an illustrious messenger.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَمَا هُوَ بِقَوْلِ شَاعِرٍۢ ۚ قَلِيلًۭا مَّا تُؤْمِنُونَ
verses.translit: Wa ma huwa biqawli shaa'ir; qaleelam maa tu'minoon
verses.translation: It is not poet's speech - little is it that ye believe!
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَلَا بِقَوْلِ كَاهِنٍۢ ۚ قَلِيلًۭا مَّا تَذَكَّرُونَ
verses.translit: Wa laa biqawli kaahin; qaleelam maa tazakkaroon
verses.translation: Nor diviner's speech - little is it that ye remember!
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: It is a revelation from the Lord of the Worlds.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: And if he had invented false sayings concerning Us,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: We assuredly had taken him by the right hand
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: And then severed his life-artery,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: فَمَا مِنكُم مِّنْ أَحَدٍ عَنْهُ حَٰجِزِينَ
verses.translation: And not one of you could have held Us off from him.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: And lo! it is a warrant unto those who ward off (evil).
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translit: Wa inna lana'lamu anna minkum mukazzibeen
verses.translation: And lo! We know that some among you will deny (it).
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: And lo! it is indeed an anguish for the disbelievers.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: And lo! it is absolute truth.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: So glorify the name of thy Tremendous Lord.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ سَأَلَ سَآئِلٌۢ بِعَذَابٍۢ وَاقِعٍۢ
verses.translation: A questioner questioned concerning the doom about to fall
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: Upon the disbelievers, which none can repel,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: From Allah, Lord of the Ascending Stairways
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: تَعْرُجُ ٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ وَٱلرُّوحُ إِلَيْهِ فِى يَوْمٍۢ كَانَ مِقْدَارُهُۥ خَمْسِينَ أَلْفَ سَنَةٍۢ
verses.translit: Ta'rujul malaaa'ikatu war Roohu ilaihi fee yawmin kaana miqdaaruhoo khamseena alfa sanah
verses.translation: (Whereby) the angels and the Spirit ascend unto Him in a Day whereof the span is fifty thousand years.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: But be patient (O Muhammad) with a patience fair to see.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: Lo! they behold it afar off
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: While we behold it nigh:
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: The day when the sky will become as molten copper,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: And the hills become as flakes of wool,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: And no familiar friend will ask a question of his friend
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: يُبَصَّرُونَهُمْ ۚ يَوَدُّ ٱلْمُجْرِمُ لَوْ يَفْتَدِى مِنْ عَذَابِ يَوْمِئِذٍۭ بِبَنِيهِ
verses.translit: Yubassaroonahum; ya waddul mujrimu law yaftadee min 'azaabi yawma'izim bibaneeh
verses.translation: Though they will be given sight of them. The guilty man will long to be able to ransom himself from the punishment of that day at the price of his children
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: And his spouse and his brother
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: And his kin that harboured him
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَمَن فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ جَمِيعًۭا ثُمَّ يُنجِيهِ
verses.translit: Wa man fil ardi jamee'an summa yunjeeh
verses.translation: And all that are in the earth, if then it might deliver him.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: But nay! for lo! it is the fire of hell
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: Eager to roast;
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: It calleth him who turned and fled (from truth),
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: And hoarded (wealth) and withheld it.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: Lo! man was created anxious,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: Fretful when evil befalleth him
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: And, when good befalleth him, grudging;
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: Save worshippers.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: Who are constant at their worship
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: And in whose wealth there is a right acknowledged
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: For the beggar and the destitute;
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: And those who believe in the Day of Judgment,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُم مِّنْ عَذَابِ رَبِّهِم مُّشْفِقُونَ
verses.translation: And those who are fearful of their Lord's doom -
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: Lo! the doom of their Lord is that before which none can feel secure -
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: And those who preserve their chastity
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: إِلَّا عَلَىٰٓ أَزْوَٰجِهِمْ أَوْ مَا مَلَكَتْ أَيْمَٰنُهُمْ فَإِنَّهُمْ غَيْرُ مَلُومِينَ
verses.translit: Illaa 'alaaa azwaajihim aw maa malakat aymaanuhum fainnahum ghairu maloomeen
verses.translation: Save with their wives and those whom their right hands possess, for thus they are not blameworthy;
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: فَمَنِ ٱبْتَغَىٰ وَرَآءَ ذَٰلِكَ فَأُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْعَادُونَ
verses.translit: Famanib taghaa waraaa'a zaalika fa ulaaa'ika humul 'aadoon
verses.translation: But whoso seeketh more than that, those are they who are transgressors;
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translit: Wallazeena hum li amaa naatihim wa 'ahdihim raa'oon
verses.translation: And those who keep their pledges and their covenant,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: And those who stand by their testimony
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: And those who are attentive at their worship.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: These will dwell in Gardens, honoured.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translit: Famaa lil lazeena kafaroo qibalaka muhti'een
verses.translation: What aileth those who disbelieve, that they keep staring toward thee (O Muhammad), open-eyed,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: On the right and on the left, in groups?
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: أَيَطْمَعُ كُلُّ ٱمْرِئٍۢ مِّنْهُمْ أَن يُدْخَلَ جَنَّةَ نَعِيمٍۢ
verses.translit: Ayatma'u kullum ri'im minhum anyyudkhala jannata Na'eem
verses.translation: Doth every man among them hope to enter the Garden of Delight?
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translit: Kallaaa innaa khalaq nahum mimmaa ya'lamoon
verses.translation: Nay, verily. Lo! We created them from what they know.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: فَلَآ أُقْسِمُ بِرَبِّ ٱلْمَشَٰرِقِ وَٱلْمَغَٰرِبِ إِنَّا لَقَٰدِرُونَ
verses.translit: Falaaa uqsimu bi Rabbil mashaariqi wal maghaaribi innaa laqaadiroon
verses.translation: But nay! I swear by the Lord of the rising-places and the setting-places of the planets that We verily are Able
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: عَلَىٰٓ أَن نُّبَدِّلَ خَيْرًۭا مِّنْهُمْ وَمَا نَحْنُ بِمَسْبُوقِينَ
verses.translit: 'Alaaa an nubaddila khairam minhum wa maa Nahnu bimasbooqeen
verses.translation: To replace them by (others) better than them. And we are not to be outrun.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: فَذَرْهُمْ يَخُوضُوا۟ وَيَلْعَبُوا۟ حَتَّىٰ يُلَٰقُوا۟ يَوْمَهُمُ ٱلَّذِى يُوعَدُونَ
verses.translit: Fazarhum yakhoodoo wa yal'aboo hattaa yulaaqoo yaw mahumul lazee yoo'adoon
verses.translation: So let them chat and play until they meet their Day which they are promised,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: يَوْمَ يَخْرُجُونَ مِنَ ٱلْأَجْدَاثِ سِرَاعًۭا كَأَنَّهُمْ إِلَىٰ نُصُبٍۢ يُوفِضُونَ
verses.translit: Yawma yakhrujoona minal ajdaasi siraa'an ka anna hum ilaa nusubiny yoofidoon
verses.translation: The day when they come forth from the graves in haste, as racing to a goal,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: خَٰشِعَةً أَبْصَٰرُهُمْ تَرْهَقُهُمْ ذِلَّةٌۭ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ ٱلْيَوْمُ ٱلَّذِى كَانُوا۟ يُوعَدُونَ
verses.translit: Khaashi'atan absaaruhum tarhaquhum zillah; zaalikal yawmul lazee kaanoo yoo'adoon
verses.translation: With eyes aghast, abasement stupefying them: Such is the Day which they are promised.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ إِنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَا نُوحًا إِلَىٰ قَوْمِهِۦٓ أَنْ أَنذِرْ قَوْمَكَ مِن قَبْلِ أَن يَأْتِيَهُمْ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌۭ
verses.translit: Innaaa arsalnaa Noohan ilaa qawmihee an anzir qawmaka min qabli any yaatiyahum 'azaabun aleem
verses.translation: Lo! We sent Noah unto his people (saying): Warn thy people ere the painful doom come unto them.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: قَالَ يَٰقَوْمِ إِنِّى لَكُمْ نَذِيرٌۭ مُّبِينٌ
verses.translit: Qaala yaa qawmi innee lakum nazeerum mubeen
verses.translation: He said: O my people! Lo! I am a plain warner unto you
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translit: Ani'udul laaha watta qoohu wa atee'oon
verses.translation: (Bidding you): Serve Allah and keep your duty unto Him and obey me,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: يَغْفِرْ لَكُم مِّن ذُنُوبِكُمْ وَيُؤَخِّرْكُمْ إِلَىٰٓ أَجَلٍۢ مُّسَمًّى ۚ إِنَّ أَجَلَ ٱللَّهِ إِذَا جَآءَ لَا يُؤَخَّرُ ۖ لَوْ كُنتُمْ تَعْلَمُونَ
verses.translit: Yaghfir lakum min zunoobikum wa yu'akhkhirkum ilaaa ajalim musammaa; innaa ajalal laahi izaa jaaa'a laa yu'akhkhar; law kuntum ta'lamoon
verses.translation: That He may forgive you somewhat of your sins and respite you to an appointed term. Lo! the term of Allah, when it cometh, cannot be delayed, if ye but knew.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: قَالَ رَبِّ إِنِّى دَعَوْتُ قَوْمِى لَيْلًۭا وَنَهَارًۭا
verses.translit: Qaala rabbi innee da'awtu qawmee lailanw wa naharaa
verses.translation: He said: My Lord! Lo! I have called unto my people night and day
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translit: Falam yazid hum du'aaa 'eee illaa firaaraa
verses.translation: But all my calling doth but add to their repugnance;
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَإِنِّى كُلَّمَا دَعَوْتُهُمْ لِتَغْفِرَ لَهُمْ جَعَلُوٓا۟ أَصَٰبِعَهُمْ فِىٓ ءَاذَانِهِمْ وَٱسْتَغْشَوْا۟ ثِيَابَهُمْ وَأَصَرُّوا۟ وَٱسْتَكْبَرُوا۟ ٱسْتِكْبَارًۭا
verses.translit: Wa inee kullamaa da'awtuhum litaghfira lahum ja'alooo asaabi'ahum fee aazaanihim wastaghshaw siyaabahum wa asaarroo wastakbarus tikbaaraa
verses.translation: And lo! whenever I call unto them that Thou mayst pardon them they thrust their fingers in their ears and cover themselves with their garments and persist (in their refusal) and magnify themselves in pride.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: And lo! I have called unto them aloud,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: ثُمَّ إِنِّىٓ أَعْلَنتُ لَهُمْ وَأَسْرَرْتُ لَهُمْ إِسْرَارًۭا
verses.translit: Summaa inneee a'lantu lahum wa asrartu lahum israaraa
verses.translation: And lo! I have made public proclamation unto them, and I have appealed to them in private.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: فَقُلْتُ ٱسْتَغْفِرُوا۟ رَبَّكُمْ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ غَفَّارًۭا
verses.translit: Faqultus taghfiroo Rabakam innahoo kaana Ghaffaaraa
verses.translation: And I have said: Seek pardon of your Lord. Lo! He was ever Forgiving.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: He will let loose the sky for you in plenteous rain,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَيُمْدِدْكُم بِأَمْوَٰلٍۢ وَبَنِينَ وَيَجْعَل لَّكُمْ جَنَّٰتٍۢ وَيَجْعَل لَّكُمْ أَنْهَٰرًۭا
verses.translit: Wa yumdidkum bi am waalinw wa baneena wa yaj'al lakum Jannaatinw wa yaj'al lakum anhaaraa
verses.translation: And will help you with wealth and sons, and will assign unto you Gardens and will assign unto you rivers.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: مَّا لَكُمْ لَا تَرْجُونَ لِلَّهِ وَقَارًۭا
verses.translit: Maa lakum laa tarjoona lillaahi waqaaraa
verses.translation: What aileth you that ye hope not toward Allah for dignity
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: When He created you by (divers) stages?
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: أَلَمْ تَرَوْا۟ كَيْفَ خَلَقَ ٱللَّهُ سَبْعَ سَمَٰوَٰتٍۢ طِبَاقًۭا
