verses.translit: Alam taraw kaifa khalaqal laahu sab'a samaawaatin tibaaqaa
verses.translation: See ye not how Allah hath created seven heavens in harmony,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَجَعَلَ ٱلْقَمَرَ فِيهِنَّ نُورًۭا وَجَعَلَ ٱلشَّمْسَ سِرَاجًۭا
verses.translit: Wa ja'alal qamara feehinna nooranw wa ja'alash shamsa siraajaa
verses.translation: And hath made the moon a light therein, and made the sun a lamp?
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: And Allah hath caused you to grow as a growth from the earth,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translit: Summa yu'eedukum feehaa wa ukhrijukum ikhraajaa
verses.translation: And afterward He maketh you return thereto, and He will bring you forth again, a (new) forthbringing.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: And Allah hath made the earth a wide expanse for you
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: That ye may thread the valley-ways thereof.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: قَالَ نُوحٌۭ رَّبِّ إِنَّهُمْ عَصَوْنِى وَٱتَّبَعُوا۟ مَن لَّمْ يَزِدْهُ مَالُهُۥ وَوَلَدُهُۥٓ إِلَّا خَسَارًۭا
verses.translit: Qaala Noohur Robbi innahum 'asawnee wattaba'oo mal lam yazid hu maaluhoo wa waladuhooo illaa khasaara
verses.translation: Noah said: My Lord! Lo! they have disobeyed me and followed one whose wealth and children increase him in naught save ruin;
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: And they have plotted a mighty plot,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَقَالُوا۟ لَا تَذَرُنَّ ءَالِهَتَكُمْ وَلَا تَذَرُنَّ وَدًّۭا وَلَا سُوَاعًۭا وَلَا يَغُوثَ وَيَعُوقَ وَنَسْرًۭا
verses.translit: Wa qaaloo laa tazarunna aalihatakum wa laa tazarunna Waddanw wa laa Suwaa'anw wa laa Yaghoosa wa Ya'ooqa wa Nasraa
verses.translation: And they have said: Forsake not your gods. Forsake not Wadd, nor Suwa', nor Yaghuth and Ya'uq and Nasr.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَقَدْ أَضَلُّوا۟ كَثِيرًۭا ۖ وَلَا تَزِدِ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ إِلَّا ضَلَٰلًۭا
verses.translit: Wa qad adalloo kasee ranw wa laa tazidiz zaalimeena illaa dalaalaa
verses.translation: And they have led many astray, and Thou increasest the wrong-doers in naught save error.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: مِّمَّا خَطِيٓـَٰٔتِهِمْ أُغْرِقُوا۟ فَأُدْخِلُوا۟ نَارًۭا فَلَمْ يَجِدُوا۟ لَهُم مِّن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ أَنصَارًۭا
verses.translit: Mimmaa khateee' aatihim ughriqoo fa udkhiloo Naaran falam yajidoo lahum min doonil laahi ansaaraa
verses.translation: Because of their sins they were drowned, then made to enter a Fire. And they found they had no helpers in place of Allah.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَقَالَ نُوحٌۭ رَّبِّ لَا تَذَرْ عَلَى ٱلْأَرْضِ مِنَ ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ دَيَّارًا
verses.translit: Wa qaala Noohur Rabbi laa tazar 'alal ardi minal kaafireena daiyaaraa
verses.translation: And Noah said: My Lord! Leave not one of the disbelievers in the land.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: إِنَّكَ إِن تَذَرْهُمْ يُضِلُّوا۟ عِبَادَكَ وَلَا يَلِدُوٓا۟ إِلَّا فَاجِرًۭا كَفَّارًۭا
verses.translit: Innaka in tazarhum yudil loo 'ibaadaka wa laa yalidooo illaa faajiran kaffaaraa
verses.translation: If Thou shouldst leave them, they will mislead Thy slaves and will beget none save lewd ingrates.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: رَّبِّ ٱغْفِرْ لِى وَلِوَٰلِدَىَّ وَلِمَن دَخَلَ بَيْتِىَ مُؤْمِنًۭا وَلِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَٱلْمُؤْمِنَٰتِ وَلَا تَزِدِ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ إِلَّا تَبَارًۢا
verses.translit: Rabbigh fir lee wa liwaa lidaiya wa liman dakhala baitiya mu'minanw wa lil mu'mineena wal mu'minaati wa laa tazidiz zaalimeena illaa tabaaraa
verses.translation: My Lord! Forgive me and my parents and him who entereth my house believing, and believing men and believing women, and increase not the wrong-doers in aught save ruin.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ قُلْ أُوحِىَ إِلَىَّ أَنَّهُ ٱسْتَمَعَ نَفَرٌۭ مِّنَ ٱلْجِنِّ فَقَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّا سَمِعْنَا قُرْءَانًا عَجَبًۭا
verses.translit: Qul oohiya ilaiya annna hustama'a nafarum minal jinnni faqaalooo innaa sami'naa quraanan 'ajabaa
verses.translation: Say (O Muhammad): It is revealed unto me that a company of the Jinn gave ear, and they said: Lo! we have heard a marvellous Qur'an,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: يَهْدِىٓ إِلَى ٱلرُّشْدِ فَـَٔامَنَّا بِهِۦ ۖ وَلَن نُّشْرِكَ بِرَبِّنَآ أَحَدًۭا
verses.translit: Yahdeee ilar rushdi fa aamannaa bihee wa lan nushrika bi rabbinaaa ahadaa
verses.translation: Which guideth unto righteousness, so we believe in it and we ascribe no partner unto our Lord.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَأَنَّهُۥ تَعَٰلَىٰ جَدُّ رَبِّنَا مَا ٱتَّخَذَ صَٰحِبَةًۭ وَلَا وَلَدًۭا
verses.translit: Wa annahoo Ta'aalaa jaddu Rabbinaa mat takhaza saahibatanw wa la waladaa
verses.translation: And (we believe) that He - exalted be the glory of our Lord! - hath taken neither wife nor son,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَأَنَّهُۥ كَانَ يَقُولُ سَفِيهُنَا عَلَى ٱللَّهِ شَطَطًۭا
verses.translit: Wa annahoo kaana yaqoolu safeehunaa 'alal laahi shatataa
verses.translation: And that the foolish one among us used to speak concerning Allah an atrocious lie.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَأَنَّا ظَنَنَّآ أَن لَّن تَقُولَ ٱلْإِنسُ وَٱلْجِنُّ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ كَذِبًۭا
verses.translit: Wa annaa zanannaaa al lan taqoolal insu wal jinnu 'alal laahi kazibaa
verses.translation: And lo! we had supposed that humankind and jinn would not speak a lie concerning Allah -
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَأَنَّهُۥ كَانَ رِجَالٌۭ مِّنَ ٱلْإِنسِ يَعُوذُونَ بِرِجَالٍۢ مِّنَ ٱلْجِنِّ فَزَادُوهُمْ رَهَقًۭا
verses.translit: Wa annahoo kaana rijaa lum minal insi ya'oozoona birijaalim minal jinni fazaa doohum rahaqaa
verses.translation: And indeed (O Muhammad) individuals of humankind used to invoke the protection of individuals of the jinn, so that they increased them in revolt against Allah);
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَأَنَّهُمْ ظَنُّوا۟ كَمَا ظَنَنتُمْ أَن لَّن يَبْعَثَ ٱللَّهُ أَحَدًۭا
verses.translit: Wa annahum zannoo kamaa zanantum al lany yab'asal laahu ahadaa
verses.translation: And indeed they supposed, even as ye suppose, that Allah would not raise anyone (from the dead) -
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَأَنَّا لَمَسْنَا ٱلسَّمَآءَ فَوَجَدْنَٰهَا مُلِئَتْ حَرَسًۭا شَدِيدًۭا وَشُهُبًۭا
verses.translit: Wa annaa lamasnas sa maaa'a fa wajadnaahaa muli'at harasan shadeedanw wa shuhubaa
verses.translation: And (the Jinn who had listened to the Qur'an said): We had sought the heaven but had found it filled with strong warders and meteors.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَأَنَّا كُنَّا نَقْعُدُ مِنْهَا مَقَٰعِدَ لِلسَّمْعِ ۖ فَمَن يَسْتَمِعِ ٱلْءَانَ يَجِدْ لَهُۥ شِهَابًۭا رَّصَدًۭا
verses.translit: Wa annaa kunnaa naq'udu minhaa maqaa'ida lis'sam'i famany yastami'il aana yajid lahoo shihaabar rasada
verses.translation: And we used to sit on places (high) therein to listen. But he who listeneth now findeth a flame in wait for him;
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَأَنَّا لَا نَدْرِىٓ أَشَرٌّ أُرِيدَ بِمَن فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ أَمْ أَرَادَ بِهِمْ رَبُّهُمْ رَشَدًۭا
verses.translit: Wa annaa laa nadreee asharrun ureeda biman fil ardi am araada bihim rabbuhum rashadaa
verses.translation: And we know not whether harm is boded unto all who are in the earth, or whether their Lord intendeth guidance for them.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَأَنَّا مِنَّا ٱلصَّٰلِحُونَ وَمِنَّا دُونَ ذَٰلِكَ ۖ كُنَّا طَرَآئِقَ قِدَدًۭا
verses.translit: Wa annaa minnas saalihoona wa minnaa doona zaalika kunnaa taraaa'ilqa qidadaa
verses.translation: And among us there are righteous folk and among us there are far from that. We are sects having different rules.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَأَنَّا ظَنَنَّآ أَن لَّن نُّعْجِزَ ٱللَّهَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَلَن نُّعْجِزَهُۥ هَرَبًۭا
verses.translit: Wa annaa zanannaaa al lan nu'jizal laaha fil ardi wa lan nu'jizahoo harabaa
verses.translation: And we know that we cannot escape from Allah in the earth, nor can we escape by flight.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَأَنَّا لَمَّا سَمِعْنَا ٱلْهُدَىٰٓ ءَامَنَّا بِهِۦ ۖ فَمَن يُؤْمِنۢ بِرَبِّهِۦ فَلَا يَخَافُ بَخْسًۭا وَلَا رَهَقًۭا
verses.translit: Wa annaa lammaa sami'nal hudaaa aamannaa bihee famany yu'mim bi rabbihee falaa yakhaafu bakhsanw wa laa rahaqaa
verses.translation: And when we heard the guidance, we believed therein, and whoso believeth in his Lord, he feareth neither loss nor oppression.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَأَنَّا مِنَّا ٱلْمُسْلِمُونَ وَمِنَّا ٱلْقَٰسِطُونَ ۖ فَمَنْ أَسْلَمَ فَأُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ تَحَرَّوْا۟ رَشَدًۭا
verses.translit: Wa annaa minnal muslimoona wa minnal qaasitoona faman aslama fa ulaaa'ika taharraw rashadaa
verses.translation: And there are among us some who have surrendered (to Allah) and there are among us some who are unjust. And whoso hath surrendered to Allah, such have taken the right path purposefully.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translit: Wa ammal qaasitoona fa kaanoo li jahannama hatabaa
verses.translation: And as for those who are unjust, they are firewood for hell.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَأَلَّوِ ٱسْتَقَٰمُوا۟ عَلَى ٱلطَّرِيقَةِ لَأَسْقَيْنَٰهُم مَّآءً غَدَقًۭا
verses.translit: Wa alla wis taqaamoo 'alat tareeqati la asqaynaahum maa'an ghadaqaa
verses.translation: If they (the idolaters) tread the right path, We shall give them to drink of water in abundance
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: لِّنَفْتِنَهُمْ فِيهِ ۚ وَمَن يُعْرِضْ عَن ذِكْرِ رَبِّهِۦ يَسْلُكْهُ عَذَابًۭا صَعَدًۭا
verses.translit: Linaftinahum feeh; wa many yu'rid 'an zikri rabbihee yasluk hu 'azaaban sa'adaa
verses.translation: That We may test them thereby, and whoso turneth away from the remembrance of his Lord; He will thrust him into ever-growing torment.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَأَنَّ ٱلْمَسَٰجِدَ لِلَّهِ فَلَا تَدْعُوا۟ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ أَحَدًۭا
verses.translit: Wa annal masaajida lillaahi falaa tad'oo ma'al laahi ahadaa
verses.translation: And the places of worship are only for Allah, so pray not unto anyone along with Allah.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَأَنَّهُۥ لَمَّا قَامَ عَبْدُ ٱللَّهِ يَدْعُوهُ كَادُوا۟ يَكُونُونَ عَلَيْهِ لِبَدًۭا
verses.translit: Wa annahoo lammaa qaama 'adul laahi yad'oohu kaadoo yakoonoona 'alaihi libadaa
verses.translation: And when the slave of Allah stood up in prayer to Him, they crowded on him, almost stifling.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: قُلْ إِنَّمَآ أَدْعُوا۟ رَبِّى وَلَآ أُشْرِكُ بِهِۦٓ أَحَدًۭا
verses.translit: Qul innamaaa ad'oo rabbee wa laaa ushriku biheee ahadaa
verses.translation: Say (unto them, O Muhammad): I pray unto Allah only, and ascribe unto Him no partner.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: قُلْ إِنِّى لَآ أَمْلِكُ لَكُمْ ضَرًّۭا وَلَا رَشَدًۭا
verses.translit: Qul innee laaa amliku lakum darranw wa laa rashadaa
verses.translation: Say: Lo! I control not hurt nor benefit for you.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: قُلْ إِنِّى لَن يُجِيرَنِى مِنَ ٱللَّهِ أَحَدٌۭ وَلَنْ أَجِدَ مِن دُونِهِۦ مُلْتَحَدًا
verses.translit: Qul innee lany yujeeranee minal laahi ahad, wa lan ajida min doonihee multahadaa
verses.translation: Say: Lo! none can protect me from Allah, nor can I find any refuge beside Him
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: إِلَّا بَلَٰغًۭا مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ وَرِسَٰلَٰتِهِۦ ۚ وَمَن يَعْصِ ٱللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُۥ فَإِنَّ لَهُۥ نَارَ جَهَنَّمَ خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَآ أَبَدًا
verses.translit: Illaa balaagham minal laahi wa risaalaatih; wa many ya'sil laaha wa rasoolahoo fa inna lahoo naara jahannama khaalideena feehaaa abadaa
verses.translation: (Mine is) but conveyance (of the Truth) from Allah, and His messages; and whoso disobeyeth Allah and His messenger, lo! his is fire of hell, wherein such dwell for ever.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا رَأَوْا۟ مَا يُوعَدُونَ فَسَيَعْلَمُونَ مَنْ أَضْعَفُ نَاصِرًۭا وَأَقَلُّ عَدَدًۭا
verses.translit: Hattaaa izaa ra aw maa yoo'adoona fasaya'lamoona man ad'afu naasiranw wa aqallu 'adadaa
verses.translation: Till (the day) when they shall behold that which they are promised (they may doubt); but then they will know (for certain) who is weaker in allies and less in multitude.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: قُلْ إِنْ أَدْرِىٓ أَقَرِيبٌۭ مَّا تُوعَدُونَ أَمْ يَجْعَلُ لَهُۥ رَبِّىٓ أَمَدًا
verses.translit: Qul in adreee a qareebum maa too'adoona am yaj'alu lahoo rabbeee amadaa
verses.translation: Say (O Muhammad, unto the disbelievers): I know not whether that which ye are promised is nigh, or if my Lord hath set a distant term for it.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: عَٰلِمُ ٱلْغَيْبِ فَلَا يُظْهِرُ عَلَىٰ غَيْبِهِۦٓ أَحَدًا
verses.translit: 'Aalimul ghaibi falaa yuzhiru alaa ghaibiheee ahadaa
verses.translation: (He is) the Knower of the Unseen, and He revealeth unto none His secret,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: إِلَّا مَنِ ٱرْتَضَىٰ مِن رَّسُولٍۢ فَإِنَّهُۥ يَسْلُكُ مِنۢ بَيْنِ يَدَيْهِ وَمِنْ خَلْفِهِۦ رَصَدًۭا
verses.translit: Illaa manir tadaa mir rasoolin fa innahoo yasluku mim baini yadihi wa min khalfihee rasadaa
verses.translation: Save unto every messenger whom He hath chosen, and then He maketh a guard to go before him and a guard behind him
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: لِّيَعْلَمَ أَن قَدْ أَبْلَغُوا۟ رِسَٰلَٰتِ رَبِّهِمْ وَأَحَاطَ بِمَا لَدَيْهِمْ وَأَحْصَىٰ كُلَّ شَىْءٍ عَدَدًۢا
verses.translit: Liya'lama an qad ablaghoo risaalaati rabbihim wa ahaata bima ladihim wa ahsaa kulla shai'in 'adadaa
verses.translation: That He may know that they have indeed conveyed the messages of their Lord. He surroundeth all their doings, and He keepeth count of all things.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلْمُزَّمِّلُ
verses.translation: O thou wrapped up in thy raiment!
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: Keep vigil the night long, save a little -
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: A half thereof, or abate a little thereof
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: أَوْ زِدْ عَلَيْهِ وَرَتِّلِ ٱلْقُرْءَانَ تَرْتِيلًا
verses.translit: Aw zid 'alaihi wa rattilil Qur'aana tarteela
verses.translation: Or add (a little) thereto - and chant the Qur'an in measure,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: For we shall charge thee with a word of weight.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: إِنَّ نَاشِئَةَ ٱلَّيْلِ هِىَ أَشَدُّ وَطْـًۭٔا وَأَقْوَمُ قِيلًا
verses.translit: Inn naashi'atal laili hiya ashadddu wat anw wa aqwamu qeelaa
verses.translation: Lo! the vigil of the night is (a time) when impression is more keen and speech more certain.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: إِنَّ لَكَ فِى ٱلنَّهَارِ سَبْحًۭا طَوِيلًۭا
verses.translit: Inna laka fin nahaari sabhan taweelaa
verses.translation: Lo! thou hast by day a chain of business.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَٱذْكُرِ ٱسْمَ رَبِّكَ وَتَبَتَّلْ إِلَيْهِ تَبْتِيلًۭا
verses.translit: Wazkuris ma rabbika wa tabattal ilaihi tabteelaa
verses.translation: So remember the name of thy Lord and devote thyself with a complete devotion -
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: رَّبُّ ٱلْمَشْرِقِ وَٱلْمَغْرِبِ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ فَٱتَّخِذْهُ وَكِيلًۭا
verses.translit: Rabbul mashriqi wal maghriibi laaa ilaaha illaa Huwa fattakhizhu wakeelaa
verses.translation: Lord of the East and the West; there is no Allah save Him; so choose thou Him alone for thy defender -
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَٱصْبِرْ عَلَىٰ مَا يَقُولُونَ وَٱهْجُرْهُمْ هَجْرًۭا جَمِيلًۭا
verses.translit: Wasbir 'alaa maa yaqoo loona wahjurhum hajran jameelaa
verses.translation: And bear with patience what they utter, and part from them with a fair leave-taking.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَذَرْنِى وَٱلْمُكَذِّبِينَ أُو۟لِى ٱلنَّعْمَةِ وَمَهِّلْهُمْ قَلِيلًا
verses.translit: Wa zarnee walmukaz zibeena ulin na'mati wa mahhilhum qaleelaa
verses.translation: Leave Me to deal with the deniers, lords of ease and comfort (in this life); and do thou respite them awhile.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: Lo! with Us are heavy fetters and a raging fire,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translit: Wa ta'aaman zaa ghussa tinw wa'azaaban aleemaa
verses.translation: And food which choketh (the partaker), and a painful doom
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: يَوْمَ تَرْجُفُ ٱلْأَرْضُ وَٱلْجِبَالُ وَكَانَتِ ٱلْجِبَالُ كَثِيبًۭا مَّهِيلًا
verses.translit: Yawma tarjuful ardu waljibaalu wa kaanatil jibaalu kaseebam maheelaa
verses.translation: On the day when the earth and the hills rock, and the hills become a heap of running sand.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: إِنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَآ إِلَيْكُمْ رَسُولًۭا شَٰهِدًا عَلَيْكُمْ كَمَآ أَرْسَلْنَآ إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ رَسُولًۭا
verses.translit: Innaa arsalnaaa ilaikum rasoolan shahidan 'alikum kamaaa arsalnaaa ilaa Fir'awna Rasoolna
verses.translation: Lo! We have sent unto you a messenger as witness against you, even as We sent unto Pharaoh a messenger.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: فَعَصَىٰ فِرْعَوْنُ ٱلرَّسُولَ فَأَخَذْنَٰهُ أَخْذًۭا وَبِيلًۭا
verses.translit: Fa'asaa Fir'awnur Rasoola fa akhaznaahu akhzanw wabeelaa
verses.translation: But Pharaoh rebelled against the messenger, whereupon We seized him with no gentle grip.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: فَكَيْفَ تَتَّقُونَ إِن كَفَرْتُمْ يَوْمًۭا يَجْعَلُ ٱلْوِلْدَٰنَ شِيبًا
verses.translit: Fakaifa tattaqoona in kafartum yawmany yaj'alul wildaana sheeba
verses.translation: Then how, if ye disbelieve, will ye protect yourselves upon the day which will turn children grey,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: ٱلسَّمَآءُ مُنفَطِرٌۢ بِهِۦ ۚ كَانَ وَعْدُهُۥ مَفْعُولًا
verses.translit: Assamaaa'u munfatirum bih; kaana wa'duhoo maf'oola
verses.translation: The very heaven being then rent asunder. His promise is to be fulfilled.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: إِنَّ هَٰذِهِۦ تَذْكِرَةٌۭ ۖ فَمَن شَآءَ ٱتَّخَذَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِۦ سَبِيلًا
verses.translit: Inna haazihee tazkiratun fa man shaaa'at takhaza ilaa Rabbihee sabeelaa
verses.translation: Lo! This is a Reminder. Let him who will, then, choose a way unto his Lord.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: ۞ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ يَعْلَمُ أَنَّكَ تَقُومُ أَدْنَىٰ مِن ثُلُثَىِ ٱلَّيْلِ وَنِصْفَهُۥ وَثُلُثَهُۥ وَطَآئِفَةٌۭ مِّنَ ٱلَّذِينَ مَعَكَ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ يُقَدِّرُ ٱلَّيْلَ وَٱلنَّهَارَ ۚ عَلِمَ أَن لَّن تُحْصُوهُ فَتَابَ عَلَيْكُمْ ۖ فَٱقْرَءُوا۟ مَا تَيَسَّرَ مِنَ ٱلْقُرْءَانِ ۚ عَلِمَ أَن سَيَكُونُ مِنكُم مَّرْضَىٰ ۙ وَءَاخَرُونَ يَضْرِبُونَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ يَبْتَغُونَ مِن فَضْلِ ٱللَّهِ ۙ وَءَاخَرُونَ يُقَٰتِلُونَ فِى سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ ۖ فَٱقْرَءُوا۟ مَا تَيَسَّرَ مِنْهُ ۚ وَأَقِيمُوا۟ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَءَاتُوا۟ ٱلزَّكَوٰةَ وَأَقْرِضُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ قَرْضًا حَسَنًۭا ۚ وَمَا تُقَدِّمُوا۟ لِأَنفُسِكُم مِّنْ خَيْرٍۢ تَجِدُوهُ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ هُوَ خَيْرًۭا وَأَعْظَمَ أَجْرًۭا ۚ وَٱسْتَغْفِرُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ ۖ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَفُورٌۭ رَّحِيمٌۢ
verses.translit: Inna Rabbaka ya'lamu annaka taqoomu adnaa min sulusa yil laili wa nisfahoo wa sulusahoo wa taaa'ifatum minal lazeena ma'ak; wal laahu yuqaddirul laila wanna haar; 'alima al lan tuhsoohu fataaba 'alaikum faqra'oo maa tayassara minal quraan; 'alima an sa yakoonu minkum mardaa wa aakharoona yadriboona fil ardi yabtaghoona min fadlil laahi wa aakharoona yuqaatiloona fee sabeelil laahi faqra'oo ma tayassara minhu wa aqeemus salaata wa aatuz zakaata wa aqridul laaha qardan hasanaa; wa maa tuqadimoo li anfusikum min khairin tajidoohu 'indal laahi huwa khayranw wa a'zama ajraa; wastaghfirul laahaa innal laaha ghafoorur raheem.
verses.translation: Lo! thy Lord knoweth how thou keepest vigil sometimes nearly two-thirds of the night, or (sometimes) half or a third thereof, as do a party of those with thee. Allah measureth the night and the day. He knoweth that ye count it not, and turneth unto you in mercy. Recite, then, of the Qur'an that which is easy for you. He knoweth that there are sick folk among you, while others travel in the land in search of Allah's bounty, and others (still) are fighting for the cause of Allah. So recite of it that which is easy (for you), and establish worship and pay the poor-due, and (so) lend unto Allah a goodly loan. Whatsoever good ye send before you for your souls, ye will find it with Allah, better and greater in the recompense. And seek forgiveness of Allah. Lo! Allah is Forgiving, Merciful.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلْمُدَّثِّرُ
verses.translation: O thou enveloped in thy cloak,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: Arise and warn!
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: Thy Lord magnify,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: Thy raiment purify,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: Pollution shun!
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: And show not favour, seeking wordly gain!
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: For the sake of thy Lord, be patient!
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: For when the trumpet shall sound,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: Surely that day will be a day of anguish,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: Not of ease, for disbelievers.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: Leave Me (to deal) with him whom I created lonely,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: And then bestowed upon him ample means,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: And sons abiding in his presence
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: And made (life) smooth for him.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: Yet he desireth that I should give more.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: Nay! For lo! he hath been stubborn to Our revelations.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: On him I shall impose a fearful doom.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: For lo! he did consider; then he planned -
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: (Self-)destroyed is he, how he planned!
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: Again (self-)destroyed is he, how he planned! -
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: Then looked he,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: Then frowned he and showed displeasure.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: Then turned he away in pride
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: فَقَالَ إِنْ هَٰذَآ إِلَّا سِحْرٌۭ يُؤْثَرُ
verses.translit: Faqaala in haazaaa illaa sihruny yu'sar
verses.translation: And said: This is naught else than magic from of old;
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: This is naught else than speech of mortal man.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: Him shall I fling unto the burning.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: - Ah, what will convey unto thee what that burning is! -
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: It leaveth naught; it spareth naught
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: It shrivelleth the man.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: Above it are nineteen.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَمَا جَعَلْنَآ أَصْحَٰبَ ٱلنَّارِ إِلَّا مَلَٰٓئِكَةًۭ ۙ وَمَا جَعَلْنَا عِدَّتَهُمْ إِلَّا فِتْنَةًۭ لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لِيَسْتَيْقِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُوا۟ ٱلْكِتَٰبَ وَيَزْدَادَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ إِيمَٰنًۭا ۙ وَلَا يَرْتَابَ ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُوا۟ ٱلْكِتَٰبَ وَٱلْمُؤْمِنُونَ ۙ وَلِيَقُولَ ٱلَّذِينَ فِى قُلُوبِهِم مَّرَضٌۭ وَٱلْكَٰفِرُونَ مَاذَآ أَرَادَ ٱللَّهُ بِهَٰذَا مَثَلًۭا ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ يُضِلُّ ٱللَّهُ مَن يَشَآءُ وَيَهْدِى مَن يَشَآءُ ۚ وَمَا يَعْلَمُ جُنُودَ رَبِّكَ إِلَّا هُوَ ۚ وَمَا هِىَ إِلَّا ذِكْرَىٰ لِلْبَشَرِ
verses.translit: Wa maaja''alnaaa As haaban naari illaa malaaa 'ikatanw wa maa ja'alnaa 'iddatahum illaa fitnatal lillazeena kafaroo liyastayqinal lazeena ootul kitaaba wa yazdaadal lazeena aamanooo eemaananw wa laa yartaabal lazeena ootul kitaaba walmu'minoona wa liyaqoolal lazeena fee quloo bihim maradunw walkaafiroona maazaaa araadal laahu bihaazaa masalaa; kazaalika yudillul laahu many yashaaa'u wa yahdee many yashaaa'; wa maa ya'lamu junooda rabbika illaa hoo; wa maa hiya illaa zikraa lil bashar
verses.translation: We have appointed only angels to be wardens of the Fire, and their number have We made to be a stumbling-block for those who disbelieve; that those to whom the Scripture hath been given may have certainty, and that believers may increase in faith; and that those to whom the Scripture hath been given and believers may not doubt; and that those in whose hearts there is disease, and disbelievers, may say: What meaneth Allah by this similitude? Thus Allah sendeth astray whom He will, and whom He will He guideth. None knoweth the hosts of thy Lord save Him. This is naught else than a Reminder unto mortals.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: Nay, by the Moon
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: And the night when it withdraweth
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: And the dawn when it shineth forth,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: Lo! this is one of the greatest (portents)
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: As a warning unto men,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: لِمَن شَآءَ مِنكُمْ أَن يَتَقَدَّمَ أَوْ يَتَأَخَّرَ
verses.translit: Liman shaaa'a minkum any yataqaddama aw yata akhkhar
verses.translation: Unto him of you who will advance or hang back.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: Every soul is a pledge for its own deeds;
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: Save those who will stand on the right hand.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: In gardens they will ask one another
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: Concerning the guilty:
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: What hath brought you to this burning?
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: They will answer: We were not of those who prayed
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: Nor did we feed the wretched.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: We used to wade (in vain dispute) with (all) waders,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translit: Wa kunnaa nukazzibu bi yawmid Deen
verses.translation: And we used to deny the Day of Judgment,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: Till the Inevitable came unto us.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: The mediation of no mediators will avail them then.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: Why now turn they away from the Admonishment,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: As they were frightened asses
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: Fleeing from a lion?
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: بَلْ يُرِيدُ كُلُّ ٱمْرِئٍۢ مِّنْهُمْ أَن يُؤْتَىٰ صُحُفًۭا مُّنَشَّرَةًۭ
verses.translit: Bal yureedu kullum ri'im minhum any yu'taa suhufam munashsharah
verses.translation: Nay, but everyone of them desireth that he should be given open pages (from Allah).
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: Nay, verily. They fear not the Hereafter.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: Nay, verily. Lo! this is an Admonishment.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: So whosoever will may heed.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَمَا يَذْكُرُونَ إِلَّآ أَن يَشَآءَ ٱللَّهُ ۚ هُوَ أَهْلُ ٱلتَّقْوَىٰ وَأَهْلُ ٱلْمَغْفِرَةِ
verses.translit: Wa maa yazkuroona illaaa any yashaaa'al laah; Huwa ahlut taqwaa wa ahlul maghfirah
verses.translation: And they will not heed unless Allah willeth (it). He is the fount of fear. He is the fount of Mercy.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ لَآ أُقْسِمُ بِيَوْمِ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ
verses.translation: Nay, I swear by the Day of Resurrection;
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translit: Wa laaa uqsimu bin nafsil lawwaamah
verses.translation: Nay, I swear by the accusing soul (that this Scripture is true).
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: Thinketh man that We shall not assemble his bones?
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: بَلَىٰ قَٰدِرِينَ عَلَىٰٓ أَن نُّسَوِّىَ بَنَانَهُۥ
verses.translation: Yea, verily. We are Able to restore his very fingers!
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: But man would fain deny what is before him.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: He asketh: When will be this Day of Resurrection?
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: But when sight is confounded
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: And the moon is eclipsed
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: And sun and moon are united,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translit: Yaqoolul insaanu yaw ma 'izin aynal mafarr
verses.translation: On that day man will cry: Whither to flee!
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: Alas! No refuge!
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: Unto thy Lord is the recourse that day.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: يُنَبَّؤُا۟ ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ يَوْمَئِذٍۭ بِمَا قَدَّمَ وَأَخَّرَ
verses.translit: Yunabba 'ul insaanu yawma 'izim bimaa qaddama wa akhkhar
verses.translation: On that day man is told the tale of that which he hath sent before and left behind.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: Oh, but man is a telling witness against himself,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: Although he tender his excuses.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: لَا تُحَرِّكْ بِهِۦ لِسَانَكَ لِتَعْجَلَ بِهِۦٓ
verses.translit: Laa tuharrik bihee lisaa naka lita'jala bih
verses.translation: Stir not thy tongue herewith to hasten it.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: Lo! upon Us (resteth) the putting together thereof and the reading thereof.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translit: Fa izaa qaraanaahu fattabi' qur aanah
verses.translation: And when We read it, follow thou the reading;
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: Then lo! upon Us (resteth) the explanation thereof.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: Nay, but ye do love the fleeting Now
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: And neglect the Hereafter.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: That day will faces be resplendent,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: Looking toward their Lord;
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: And that day will other faces be despondent,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: Thou wilt know that some great disaster is about to fall on them.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: Nay, but when the life cometh up to the throat
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: And men say: Where is the wizard (who can save him now)?
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: And he knoweth that it is the parting;
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: And agony is heaped on agony;
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: Unto thy Lord that day will be the driving.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: For he neither trusted, nor prayed.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: But he denied and flouted.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: Then went he to his folk with glee.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: Nearer unto thee and nearer,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: Again nearer unto thee and nearer (is the doom).
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: Thinketh man that he is to be left aimless?
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: أَلَمْ يَكُ نُطْفَةًۭ مِّن مَّنِىٍّۢ يُمْنَىٰ
verses.translit: Alam yaku nutfatam mim maniyyiny yumnaa
verses.translation: Was he not a drop of fluid which gushed forth?
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: Then he became a clot; then (Allah) shaped and fashioned
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translit: Faja'ala minhuz zawjayniz zakara wal unsaa
verses.translation: And made of him a pair, the male and female.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: أَلَيْسَ ذَٰلِكَ بِقَٰدِرٍ عَلَىٰٓ أَن يُحْۦِىَ ٱلْمَوْتَىٰ
verses.translit: Alaisa zaalika biqaadirin 'alaaa any yuhyiyal mawtaa
verses.translation: Is not He (Who doeth so) Able to bring the dead to life?
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ هَلْ أَتَىٰ عَلَى ٱلْإِنسَٰنِ حِينٌۭ مِّنَ ٱلدَّهْرِ لَمْ يَكُن شَيْـًۭٔا مَّذْكُورًا
verses.translit: Hal ataa 'alal insaani heenum minad dahri lam yakun shai'am mazkooraa
verses.translation: Hath there come upon man (ever) any period of time in which he was a thing unremembered?
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: إِنَّا خَلَقْنَا ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ مِن نُّطْفَةٍ أَمْشَاجٍۢ نَّبْتَلِيهِ فَجَعَلْنَٰهُ سَمِيعًۢا بَصِيرًا
verses.translit: Innaa khalaqnal insaana min nutfatin amshaajin nabta leehi faja'alnaahu samee'am baseeraa
verses.translation: Lo! We create man from a drop of thickened fluid to test him; so We make him hearing, knowing.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: إِنَّا هَدَيْنَٰهُ ٱلسَّبِيلَ إِمَّا شَاكِرًۭا وَإِمَّا كَفُورًا
verses.translit: Innaa hadainaahus sabeela immaa shaakiranw wa immaa kafoora
verses.translation: Lo! We have shown him the way, whether he be grateful or disbelieving.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: إِنَّآ أَعْتَدْنَا لِلْكَٰفِرِينَ سَلَٰسِلَا۟ وَأَغْلَٰلًۭا وَسَعِيرًا
verses.translit: Innaaa a'tadnaa lilkaa fireena salaasila wa aghlaalanw wa sa'eeraa
verses.translation: Lo! We have prepared for disbelievers manacles and carcans and a raging fire.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: إِنَّ ٱلْأَبْرَارَ يَشْرَبُونَ مِن كَأْسٍۢ كَانَ مِزَاجُهَا كَافُورًا
verses.translit: innal abraara yashra boona min kaasin kaana mizaa juhaa kaafooraa
verses.translation: Lo! the righteous shall drink of a cup whereof the mixture is of Kafur,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: عَيْنًۭا يَشْرَبُ بِهَا عِبَادُ ٱللَّهِ يُفَجِّرُونَهَا تَفْجِيرًۭا
verses.translation: A spring wherefrom the slaves of Allah drink, making it gush forth abundantly,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: يُوفُونَ بِٱلنَّذْرِ وَيَخَافُونَ يَوْمًۭا كَانَ شَرُّهُۥ مُسْتَطِيرًۭا
verses.translit: Yoofoona binnazri wa yakhaafoona yawman kaana sharruhoo mustateeraa
verses.translation: (Because) they perform the vow and fear a day whereof the evil is wide-spreading,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَيُطْعِمُونَ ٱلطَّعَامَ عَلَىٰ حُبِّهِۦ مِسْكِينًۭا وَيَتِيمًۭا وَأَسِيرًا
verses.translit: Wa yut''imoonat ta'aama 'alaa hubbihee miskeenanw wa yatemanw wa aseeraa
verses.translation: And feed with food the needy wretch, the orphan and the prisoner, for love of Him,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: إِنَّمَا نُطْعِمُكُمْ لِوَجْهِ ٱللَّهِ لَا نُرِيدُ مِنكُمْ جَزَآءًۭ وَلَا شُكُورًا
verses.translit: Innaamaa nut'imukum li wajhil laahi laa nureedu minkum jazaaa'anw wa laa shukooraa
verses.translation: (Saying): We feed you, for the sake of Allah only. We wish for no reward nor thanks from you;
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: إِنَّا نَخَافُ مِن رَّبِّنَا يَوْمًا عَبُوسًۭا قَمْطَرِيرًۭا
verses.translit: Innaa nakhaafu mir Rabbinna Yawman 'aboosan qamtareeraa
verses.translation: Lo! we fear from our Lord a day of frowning and of fate.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: فَوَقَىٰهُمُ ٱللَّهُ شَرَّ ذَٰلِكَ ٱلْيَوْمِ وَلَقَّىٰهُمْ نَضْرَةًۭ وَسُرُورًۭا
verses.translit: Fa waqaahumul laahu sharra zaalikal yawmi wa laqqaahum nadratanw wa surooraa
verses.translation: Therefor Allah hath warded off from them the evil of that day, and hath made them find brightness and joy;
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translit: Wa jazaahum bimaa sabaroo janatanw wa hareeraa
verses.translation: And hath awarded them for all that they endured, a Garden and silk attire;
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: مُّتَّكِـِٔينَ فِيهَا عَلَى ٱلْأَرَآئِكِ ۖ لَا يَرَوْنَ فِيهَا شَمْسًۭا وَلَا زَمْهَرِيرًۭا
verses.translit: muttaki'eena feeha 'alal araaa 'iki laa yarawna feehaa shamsanw wa laa zamhareeraa
verses.translation: Reclining therein upon couches, they will find there neither (heat of) a sun nor bitter cold.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَدَانِيَةً عَلَيْهِمْ ظِلَٰلُهَا وَذُلِّلَتْ قُطُوفُهَا تَذْلِيلًۭا
verses.translit: Wa daaniyatan 'alaihim zilaaluhaa wa zullilat qutoofu haa tazleela
verses.translation: The shade thereof is close upon them and the clustered fruits thereof bow down.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَيُطَافُ عَلَيْهِم بِـَٔانِيَةٍۢ مِّن فِضَّةٍۢ وَأَكْوَابٍۢ كَانَتْ قَوَارِيرَا۠
verses.translit: Wa yutaafu 'alaihim bi aaniyatim min fiddatinw wa akwaabin kaanat qawaareeraa
verses.translation: Goblets of silver are brought round for them, and beakers (as) of glass
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: (Bright as) glass but (made) of silver, which they (themselves) have measured to the measure (of their deeds).
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَيُسْقَوْنَ فِيهَا كَأْسًۭا كَانَ مِزَاجُهَا زَنجَبِيلًا
verses.translit: Wa yusawna feehaa kaasan kaana mizaajuhaa zanjabeelaa
verses.translation: There are they watered with a cup whereof the mixture is of Zanjabil,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: (The water of) a spring therein, named Salsabil.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: ۞ وَيَطُوفُ عَلَيْهِمْ وِلْدَٰنٌۭ مُّخَلَّدُونَ إِذَا رَأَيْتَهُمْ حَسِبْتَهُمْ لُؤْلُؤًۭا مَّنثُورًۭا
verses.translit: Wa yatoofu 'alaihim wildaanum mukhalladoona izaa ra aytahum hasibtahum lu'lu 'am mansoora
verses.translation: There wait on them immortal youths, whom, when thou seest, thou wouldst take for scattered pearls.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَإِذَا رَأَيْتَ ثَمَّ رَأَيْتَ نَعِيمًۭا وَمُلْكًۭا كَبِيرًا
verses.translit: Wa izaa ra ayta summa ra ayta na'eemanw wa mulkan kabeera
verses.translation: When thou seest, thou wilt see there bliss and high estate.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: عَٰلِيَهُمْ ثِيَابُ سُندُسٍ خُضْرٌۭ وَإِسْتَبْرَقٌۭ ۖ وَحُلُّوٓا۟ أَسَاوِرَ مِن فِضَّةٍۢ وَسَقَىٰهُمْ رَبُّهُمْ شَرَابًۭا طَهُورًا
verses.translit: 'Aaliyahum siyaabu sundusin khudrunw wa istabraq, wa hullooo asaawira min fiddatinw wa saqaahum Rabbuhum sharaaban tahooraa
verses.translation: Their raiment will be fine green silk and gold embroidery. Bracelets of silver will they wear. Their Lord will slake their thirst with a pure drink.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: إِنَّ هَٰذَا كَانَ لَكُمْ جَزَآءًۭ وَكَانَ سَعْيُكُم مَّشْكُورًا
verses.translit: Innaa haazaa kaana lakum jazz 'anw wa kaana sa'yukum mashkooraa
verses.translation: (And it will be said unto them): Lo! this is a reward for you. Your endeavour (upon earth) hath found acceptance.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: إِنَّا نَحْنُ نَزَّلْنَا عَلَيْكَ ٱلْقُرْءَانَ تَنزِيلًۭا
verses.translation: Lo! We, even We, have revealed unto thee the Qur'an, a revelation;
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: فَٱصْبِرْ لِحُكْمِ رَبِّكَ وَلَا تُطِعْ مِنْهُمْ ءَاثِمًا أَوْ كَفُورًۭا
verses.translit: Fasbir lihukmi Rabbika wa laa tuti' minhum aasiman aw kafooraa
verses.translation: So submit patiently to thy Lord's command, and obey not of them any guilty one or disbeliever.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translit: Wazkuris ma Rabbika bukratanw wa aseelaa
verses.translation: Remember the name of thy Lord at morn and evening.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَمِنَ ٱلَّيْلِ فَٱسْجُدْ لَهُۥ وَسَبِّحْهُ لَيْلًۭا طَوِيلًا
verses.translit: Wa minal laili fasjud lahoo wa sabbihhu lailan taweelaa
verses.translation: And worship Him (a portion) of the night. And glorify Him through the livelong night.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: إِنَّ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ يُحِبُّونَ ٱلْعَاجِلَةَ وَيَذَرُونَ وَرَآءَهُمْ يَوْمًۭا ثَقِيلًۭا
verses.translit: Inna haaa'ulaa'i yuhibboona 'aajilata wa yazaroona waraaa'ahum yawman saqeelaa
verses.translation: Lo! these love fleeting life, and put behind them (the remembrance of) a grievous day.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: نَّحْنُ خَلَقْنَٰهُمْ وَشَدَدْنَآ أَسْرَهُمْ ۖ وَإِذَا شِئْنَا بَدَّلْنَآ أَمْثَٰلَهُمْ تَبْدِيلًا
verses.translit: Nahnu khalaqnaahum wa shadadnaaa asrahum wa izaa shi'naa baddalnaaa amsaala hum tabdeelaa
verses.translation: We, even We, created them, and strengthened their frame. And when We will, We can replace them, bringing others like them in their stead.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: إِنَّ هَٰذِهِۦ تَذْكِرَةٌۭ ۖ فَمَن شَآءَ ٱتَّخَذَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِۦ سَبِيلًۭا
verses.translit: Inna haazihee tazkiratun fa man shaaa'at takhaza ilaa rabbihee sabeela
verses.translation: Lo! this is an Admonishment, that whosoever will may choose a way unto his Lord.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَمَا تَشَآءُونَ إِلَّآ أَن يَشَآءَ ٱللَّهُ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ كَانَ عَلِيمًا حَكِيمًۭا
verses.translit: Wa maa tashaaa'oona illaa anyyashaaa'al laah; innal laahaa kaana'Aleeman Hakeema
verses.translation: Yet ye will not, unless Allah willeth. Lo! Allah is Knower, Wise.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: يُدْخِلُ مَن يَشَآءُ فِى رَحْمَتِهِۦ ۚ وَٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ أَعَدَّ لَهُمْ عَذَابًا أَلِيمًۢا
verses.translit: Yudkhilu mai yashaaa'u fee rahmatih; wazzaalimeena a'adda lahum 'azaaban aleemaa
verses.translation: He maketh whom He will to enter His mercy, and for evil-doers hath prepared a painful doom.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ وَٱلْمُرْسَلَٰتِ عُرْفًۭا
verses.translation: By the emissary winds, (sent) one after another
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: By the raging hurricanes,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: By those which cause earth's vegetation to revive;
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: By those who winnow with a winnowing,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: By those who bring down the Reminder,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: To excuse or to warn,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: Surely that which ye are promised will befall.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: So when the stars are put out,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: And when the sky is riven asunder,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: And when the mountains are blown away,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: And when the messengers are brought unto their time appointed -
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: For what day is the time appointed?
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: For the Day of Decision.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translit: Wa maaa adraaka maa yawmul fasl
verses.translation: And what will convey unto thee what the Day of Decision is! -
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: Woe unto the repudiators on that day!
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: Destroyed We not the former folk,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: Then caused the latter folk to follow after?
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: Thus deal We ever with the guilty.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: Woe unto the repudiators on that day!
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: Did We not create you from a base fluid
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: Which We laid up in a safe abode
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: For a known term?
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: Thus We arranged. How excellent is Our arranging!
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: Woe unto the repudiators on that day!
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: Have We not made the earth a receptacle
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: Both for the living and the dead,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَجَعَلْنَا فِيهَا رَوَٰسِىَ شَٰمِخَٰتٍۢ وَأَسْقَيْنَٰكُم مَّآءًۭ فُرَاتًۭا
verses.translit: Wa ja'alnaa feehaa rawaasiya shaamikhaatinw wa asqainaakum maaa'an furaataa
verses.translation: And placed therein high mountains and given you to drink sweet water therein?
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: Woe unto the repudiators on that day!
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: ٱنطَلِقُوٓا۟ إِلَىٰ مَا كُنتُم بِهِۦ تُكَذِّبُونَ
verses.translit: Intaliqooo ilaa maa kuntum bihee tukazziboon
verses.translation: (It will be said unto them:) Depart unto that (doom) which ye used to deny;
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: ٱنطَلِقُوٓا۟ إِلَىٰ ظِلٍّۢ ذِى ثَلَٰثِ شُعَبٍۢ
verses.translit: Intaliqooo ilaa zillin zee salaasi shu'ab
verses.translation: Depart unto the shadow falling threefold,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: لَّا ظَلِيلٍۢ وَلَا يُغْنِى مِنَ ٱللَّهَبِ
verses.translit: Laa zaleelinw wa laa yughnee minal lahab
verses.translation: (Which yet is) no relief nor shelter from the flame.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: Lo! it throweth up sparks like the castles,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: (Or) as it might be camels of bright yellow hue.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: Woe unto the repudiators on that day!
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: This is a day wherein they speak not,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translit: Wa laa yu'zanu lahum fa ya'taziroon
verses.translation: Nor are they suffered to put forth excuses.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: Woe unto the repudiators on that day!
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translit: Haaza yawmul fasli jama 'naakum wal awwaleen
verses.translation: This is the Day of Decision, We have brought you and the men of old together.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translit: Fa in kaana lakum kaidun fakeedoon
verses.translation: If now ye have any wit, outwit Me.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: Woe unto the repudiators on that day!
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: Lo! those who kept their duty are amid shade and fountains,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: And fruits such as they desire.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: كُلُوا۟ وَٱشْرَبُوا۟ هَنِيٓـًٔۢا بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ
verses.translit: Kuloo washraboo haneee 'am bimaa kuntum ta'maloon
verses.translation: (Unto them it is said:) Eat, drink and welcome, O ye blessed, in return for what ye did.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: Thus do We reward the good.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: Woe unto the repudiators on that day!
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translit: Kuloo wa tamatta'oo qaleelan innakum mujrimoon
verses.translation: Eat and take your ease (on earth) a little. Lo! ye are guilty.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: Woe unto the repudiators on that day!
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَإِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمُ ٱرْكَعُوا۟ لَا يَرْكَعُونَ
verses.translit: Wa izaa qeela lahumur ka'oo aa yarka'oon
verses.translation: When it is said unto them: Bow down, they bow not down!
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: Woe unto the repudiators on that day!
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: In what statement, after this, will they believe?
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ عَمَّ يَتَسَآءَلُونَ
verses.translation: Whereof do they question one another?
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: (It is) of the awful tidings,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: Concerning which they are in disagreement.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: Nay, but they will come to know!
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: Nay, again, but they will come to know!
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: Have We not made the earth an expanse,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: And the high hills bulwarks?
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: And We have created you in pairs,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: And have appointed your sleep for repose,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: And have appointed the night as a cloak,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: And have appointed the day for livelihood.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translit: Wa banaina fauqakum sab 'an shi daada
verses.translation: And We have built above you seven strong (heavens),
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: And have appointed a dazzling lamp,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translit: Wa anzalna minal m'usiraati maa-an saj-jaaja
verses.translation: And have sent down from the rainy clouds abundant water,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translit: Linukh rija bihee habbaw wana baata
verses.translation: Thereby to produce grain and plant,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: And gardens of thick foliage.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: Lo! the Day of Decision is a fixed time,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: يَوْمَ يُنفَخُ فِى ٱلصُّورِ فَتَأْتُونَ أَفْوَاجًۭا
verses.translit: Yauma yun fakhu fis-soori fataa toona afwaaja
verses.translation: A day when the trumpet is blown and ye come in multitudes,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translit: Wa futiha tis samaa-u fakaanat abwaaba
verses.translation: And the heaven is opened and becometh as gates,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translit: Wa suyyi raatil jibaalu fa kaanat saraaba
verses.translation: And the hills are set in motion and become as a mirage.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: Lo! hell lurketh in ambush,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: A home for the rebellious.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: They will abide therein for ages.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: لَّا يَذُوقُونَ فِيهَا بَرْدًۭا وَلَا شَرَابًا
verses.translit: Laa ya zooqoona feeha bar daw walaa sharaaba
verses.translation: Therein taste they neither coolness nor (any) drink
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: Save boiling water and a paralysing cold:
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: Reward proportioned (to their evil deeds).
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: For lo! they looked not for a reckoning;
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translit: Wa kazzabu bi aayaa tina kizzaba
verses.translation: They called Our revelations false with strong denial.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translit: Wa kulla shai-in ahsai naahu kitaa ba
verses.translation: Everything have We recorded in a Book.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translit: Fa zooqoo falan-nazee dakum ill-laa azaaba
verses.translation: So taste (of that which ye have earned). No increase do We give you save of torment.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: Lo! for the duteous is achievement -
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: Gardens enclosed and vineyards,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: And voluptuous women of equal age;
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: And a full cup.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: لَّا يَسْمَعُونَ فِيهَا لَغْوًۭا وَلَا كِذَّٰبًۭا
verses.translit: Laa yasma'oona fiha lagh waw walaa kizzaba
verses.translation: There hear they never vain discourse, nor lying -
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: Requital from thy Lord - a gift in payment -
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: رَّبِّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ۖ لَا يَمْلِكُونَ مِنْهُ خِطَابًۭا
verses.translit: Rabbis samaa waati wal ardi wa maa baina humar rahmaani laa yam likoona minhu khi taaba
verses.translation: Lord of the heavens and the earth, and (all) that is between them, the Beneficent; with Whom none can converse.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: يَوْمَ يَقُومُ ٱلرُّوحُ وَٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ صَفًّۭا ۖ لَّا يَتَكَلَّمُونَ إِلَّا مَنْ أَذِنَ لَهُ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنُ وَقَالَ صَوَابًۭا
verses.translit: Yauma yaqoo mur roohu wal malaa-ikatu saf-fal laa yata kalla moona illa man azina lahur rahmaanu wa qaala sawaaba
verses.translation: On the day when the angels and the Spirit stand arrayed, they speak not, saving him whom the Beneficent alloweth and who speaketh right.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: ذَٰلِكَ ٱلْيَوْمُ ٱلْحَقُّ ۖ فَمَن شَآءَ ٱتَّخَذَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِۦ مَـَٔابًا
verses.translit: Zaalikal yaumul haqqu faman shaa-at ta khaaza ill-laa rabbihi ma-aaba
verses.translation: That is the True Day. So whoso will should seek recourse unto his Lord.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: إِنَّآ أَنذَرْنَٰكُمْ عَذَابًۭا قَرِيبًۭا يَوْمَ يَنظُرُ ٱلْمَرْءُ مَا قَدَّمَتْ يَدَاهُ وَيَقُولُ ٱلْكَافِرُ يَٰلَيْتَنِى كُنتُ تُرَٰبًۢا
verses.translit: In naa anzar naakum azaaban qareebaiy-yauma yan zurul marr-u maa qaddamat yadaahu wa ya qoolul-kaafiru yaa lai tanee kuntu turaaba
verses.translation: Lo! We warn you of a doom at hand, a day whereon a man will look on that which his own hands have sent before, and the disbeliever will cry: "Would that I were dust!"
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ وَٱلنَّٰزِعَٰتِ غَرْقًۭا
verses.translation: By those who drag forth to destruction,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: By the meteors rushing,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: By the lone stars floating,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: By the angels hastening,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: And those who govern the event,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: On the day when the first trump resoundeth.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: And the second followeth it,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: On that day hearts beat painfully
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: While eyes are downcast
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translit: Ya qoo loona a-inna lamar doo doona fil haafirah
verses.translation: (Now) they are saying: Shall we really be restored to our first state
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: Even after we are crumbled bones?
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: They say: Then that would be a vain proceeding.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: Surely it will need but one shout,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: And lo! they will be awakened.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: Hath there come unto thee the history of Moses?
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: إِذْ نَادَىٰهُ رَبُّهُۥ بِٱلْوَادِ ٱلْمُقَدَّسِ طُوًى
verses.translit: Iz nadaahu rabbuhu bil waadil-muqad dasi tuwa
verses.translation: How his Lord called him in the holy vale of Tuwa,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: (Saying:) Go thou unto Pharaoh - Lo! he hath rebelled -
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: فَقُلْ هَل لَّكَ إِلَىٰٓ أَن تَزَكَّىٰ
verses.translation: And say (unto him): Hast thou (will) to grow (in grace)?
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translit: Wa ahdi yaka ila rabbika fatakh sha
verses.translation: Then I will guide thee to thy Lord and thou shalt fear (Him).
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: And he showed him the tremendous token.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: But he denied and disobeyed,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: Then turned he away in haste,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: Then gathered he and summoned
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: And proclaimed: "I (Pharaoh) am your Lord the Highest."
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translit: Fa-akha zahul laahu nakalal aakhirati wal-oola.
verses.translation: So Allah seized him (and made him) an example for the after (life) and for the former.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَعِبْرَةًۭ لِّمَن يَخْشَىٰٓ
verses.translation: Lo! herein is indeed a lesson for him who feareth.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: ءَأَنتُمْ أَشَدُّ خَلْقًا أَمِ ٱلسَّمَآءُ ۚ بَنَىٰهَا
verses.translit: A-antum a shaddu khalqan amis samaa-u banaaha.
verses.translation: Are ye the harder to create, or is the heaven that He built?
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: He raised the height thereof and ordered it;
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translit: Wa aghtasha lailaha wa akhraja duhaaha.
verses.translation: And He made dark the night thereof, and He brought forth the morn thereof.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: And after that He spread the earth,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: And produced therefrom the water thereof and the pasture thereof,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: And He made fast the hills,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: A provision for you and for your cattle.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: But when the great disaster cometh,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translit: Yauma Yata zakkarul insaanu ma sa'aa.
verses.translation: The day when man will call to mind his (whole) endeavour,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: And hell will stand forth visible to him who seeth,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: Then, as for him who rebelled
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: And chose the life of the world,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: Lo! hell will be his home.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَأَمَّا مَنْ خَافَ مَقَامَ رَبِّهِۦ وَنَهَى ٱلنَّفْسَ عَنِ ٱلْهَوَىٰ
verses.translit: Wa ammaa man khaafa maqaama Rabbihee wa nahan nafsa 'anil hawaa
verses.translation: But as for him who feared to stand before his Lord and restrained his soul from lust,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: Lo! the Garden will be his home.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: They ask thee of the Hour: when will it come to port?
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: Why (ask they)? What hast thou to tell thereof?
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: Unto thy Lord belongeth (knowledge of) the term thereof.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: Thou art but a warner unto him who feareth it.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: كَأَنَّهُمْ يَوْمَ يَرَوْنَهَا لَمْ يَلْبَثُوٓا۟ إِلَّا عَشِيَّةً أَوْ ضُحَىٰهَا
verses.translit: Ka annahum Yawma yarawnahaa lam yalbasooo illaa 'ashiyyatan aw duhaahaa
verses.translation: On the day when they behold it, it will be as if they had but tarried for an evening or the morn thereof.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ عَبَسَ وَتَوَلَّىٰٓ
verses.translation: He frowned and turned away
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: Because the blind man came unto him.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translit: Wa maa yudreeka la'allahu yaz zakkaa.
verses.translation: What could inform thee but that he might grow (in grace)
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translit: Au yaz zak karu fatanfa 'ahuz zikraa.
verses.translation: Or take heed and so the reminder might avail him?
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: As for him who thinketh himself independent,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: Unto him thou payest regard.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: Yet it is not thy concern if he grow not (in grace).
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: But as for him who cometh unto thee with earnest purpose
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: And hath fear,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: From him thou art distracted.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: Nay, but verily it is an Admonishment,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: So let whosoever will pay heed to it,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: On honoured leaves
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: Exalted, purified,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: (Set down) by scribes
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: Noble and righteous.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: Man is (self-)destroyed: how ungrateful!
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: From what thing doth He create him?
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: From a drop of seed. He createth him and proportioneth him,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: Then maketh the way easy for him,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: Then causeth him to die, and burieth him;
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: Then, when He will, He bringeth him again to life.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: Nay, but (man) hath not done what He commanded him.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: Let man consider his food:
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: How We pour water in showers
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: Then split the earth in clefts
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: And cause the grain to grow therein
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: And grapes and green fodder
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: And olive-trees and palm-trees
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: And garden-closes of thick foliage
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: And fruits and grasses:
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: Provision for you and your cattle.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: But when the Shout cometh
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: On the day when a man fleeth from his brother
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: And his mother and his father
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: And his wife and his children,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: لِكُلِّ ٱمْرِئٍۢ مِّنْهُمْ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ شَأْنٌۭ يُغْنِيهِ
verses.translation: Every man that day will have concern enough to make him heedless (of others).
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: On that day faces will be bright as dawn,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: Laughing, rejoicing at good news;
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: And other faces, on that day, with dust upon them,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: Veiled in darkness,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: Those are the disbelievers, the wicked.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ إِذَا ٱلشَّمْسُ كُوِّرَتْ
verses.translation: When the sun is overthrown,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: And when the stars fall,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: And when the hills are moved,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: And when the camels big with young are abandoned,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: And when the wild beasts are herded together,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: And when the seas rise,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: And when souls are reunited,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: And when the girl-child that was buried alive is asked
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: For what sin she was slain,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: And when the pages are laid open,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: And when the sky is torn away,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: And when hell is lighted,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: And when the Garden is brought nigh,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: (Then) every soul will know what it hath made ready.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: Oh, but I call to witness the planets,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: The stars which rise and set,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: And the close of night,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: And the breath of morning
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: That this is in truth the word of an honoured messenger,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: ذِى قُوَّةٍ عِندَ ذِى ٱلْعَرْشِ مَكِينٍۢ
verses.translation: Mighty, established in the presence of the Lord of the Throne,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: (One) to be obeyed, and trustworthy;
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: And your comrade is not mad.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translit: Wa laqad ra aahu bilufuqil mubeen
verses.translation: Surely he beheld Him on the clear horizon.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: And he is not avid of the Unseen.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translit: Wa maa huwa biqawli shaitaanir rajeem
verses.translation: Nor is this the utterance of a devil worthy to be stoned.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: Whither then go ye?
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: This is naught else than a reminder unto creation,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: Unto whomsoever of you willeth to walk straight.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَمَا تَشَآءُونَ إِلَّآ أَن يَشَآءَ ٱللَّهُ رَبُّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
verses.translit: Wa maa tashaaa'oona illaaa ai yashaaa 'al laahu Rabbul 'Aalameen
verses.translation: And ye will not, unless (it be) that Allah willeth, the Lord of Creation.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ إِذَا ٱلسَّمَآءُ ٱنفَطَرَتْ
verses.translation: When the heaven is cleft asunder,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: When the planets are dispersed,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: When the seas are poured forth,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: And the sepulchres are overturned,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: A soul will know what it hath sent before (it) and what left behind.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ مَا غَرَّكَ بِرَبِّكَ ٱلْكَرِيمِ
verses.translit: Yaaa ayyuhal insaaanu maa gharraka bi Rabbikal kareem
verses.translation: O man! What hath made thee careless concerning thy Lord, the Bountiful,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: Who created thee, then fashioned, then proportioned thee?
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: فِىٓ أَىِّ صُورَةٍۢ مَّا شَآءَ رَكَّبَكَ
verses.translit: Feee ayye sooratim maa shaaa'a rakkabak
verses.translation: Into whatsoever form He will, He casteth thee.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: Nay, but ye deny the Judgment.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: Lo! there are above you guardians,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: Generous and recording,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: Who know (all) that ye do.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: Lo! the righteous verily will be in delight.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: And lo! the wicked verily will be in hell;
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: They will burn therein on the Day of Judgment,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.translation: And will not be absent thence.
